Demon Slayer Mark The is a mysterious marking that Demon Slayers can awaken under specific conditions. Overview. Demon Slayer Marks are irregularities on a Demon Slayer's skin that resembles a birthmark. It commonly appears on the face or another visible location of the body of Demon Slayers. Each Demon Slayer possesses a unique pattern to their Mark which appear to be based on the Breathing Style they utilize; the only known exceptions are Tanjiro Kamado, Yoriichi Tsugikuni, and Kokushibo, all three of which have Demon Slayer Marks resembling flames that manifest on the left side of their foreheads. The Mark can only be awakened under very specific conditions and grants special abilities while also enhancing pre-existing traits of the bearer. Once awakened, the Mark can disappear after a period of time along with its effects, though it can be re-activated (as seen with Muichiro Tokito and Tanjiro Kamado) by meeting the same conditions, or through training to maintain the "Marked State" to prevent it from dissipating in the first place. One special property of the Mark is its ability to spread from one bearer to the other as if they are resonating which each other. Tanjiro Kamado's Demon Slayer Mark has been shown to increase in length repeatedly after awakening it, although it is unknown if this trait is exclusive to him or if it also manifests in other Demon Slayers. Unlocking. For one to awaken the Demon Slayer Mark, they must survive extremely life-threatening conditions, specifically a heart rate of over 200 beats per minute and a body temperature of over 39° Celsius (102.2° Fahrenheit), conditions which can prove to be fatal in most cases. Muichiro Tokito states that survival is the key difference that separates those that are marked and those who fail to awaken it. However, perhaps the most important prerequisite is being in contact with an individual that possesses the Mark or has been marked before. Without fulfilling this condition, it cannot be awakened at all. Origin. During the, the Golden Age of Demon Slayers, the progenitors of the first ever Breathing Styles all manifested markings on their bodies, which later came to be known as Demon Slayer Marks. The first wielder of the Demon Slayer Mark is Yoriichi Tsugikuni, the strongest Demon Slayer in existence as well as the progenitor of Breathing Styles. Unlike other Demon Slayers that have to meet specific conditions to activate the Mark, Yoriichi was born with it. Upon joining the Demon Slayer Corps, Yoriichi spread the Mark to all other swordsmen in the organization. Despite how common the Mark was among the Demon Slayers during that era, most records of the Mark were lost to time either because the bearers then did not think preserving the information was important and/or because the information was lost in the many times the Demon Slayer Corps was nearly annihilated. Abilities. Bright Red Nichirin Sword: Bearers of the Demon Slayer Mark can dye their Nichirin Swords a shining bright red color mainly through clashing their blade with another marked swordsman's or gripping it with tremendous force. Bright Red Nichirin Swords have the ability to generate intense heat and also hamper the regeneration of demons, some of which on the level of the strongest Upper Ranks of the Twelve Kizuki and the Demon King himself. Enhanced Physical Capabilities: Upon awakening the Demon Slayer Mark, the physical strength and speed of the bearer is exponentially increased to the point where Hashira or Hashira-level Demon Slayers are able to overpower and defeat the Upper Ranks of the Twelve Kizuki and grow in power comparable to the highest among them. It is implied that the bearer's physical arm strength is increased by around 100x after awakening the mark, though it could be a hyperbole and thus the value could be much lower. The increase in the speed of the bearer is quite apparent as well, as seen when Muichiro Tokito, who was initially having trouble dealing with Gyokko's various techniques, became capable of regularly out-speeding and even blitzing Gyokko in his true form after activating his mark. Enhanced Resistance: The Demon Slayer Mark increases the bearer's resistance to Muzan Kibutsuji's demon-transforming blood, much like Total Concentration Breathing. Transparent World: Bearers of the Demon Slayer Mark can potentially gain access and see into the Transparent World, allowing them to perceive the bodies of others as if their skin was transparent. This enables them to track the flow of blood, breathing, muscular contractions and joint movements of the person they are looking at, which can be used to predict their movements and evade their attacks with ease. Additionally, those who can access the Transparent World can perceive the world in slow-motion, further increasing their reaction and movement speed. Curse of the Demon Slayer Mark. Awakening the Demon Slayer Mark comes at a steep price. Demon Slayers who have awakened their mark are said to, without exception, die before reaching the age of 25. Kokushibo states that awakening the mark merely reduces the lifespans of their bearers in exchange for greater power, while Gyomei Himejima describes it as "paying one's lifespan in advance in the exchange for a greater physique." However, Kokushibo managed to survive through accepting Muzan Kibutsuji's offer to become a demon, living for roughly another four centuries after aging past 25, indicating that gaining eternal life through demonification allows one to cheat the mark's curse. Despite what the curse entails, it is still possible to awaken the mark after a Demon Slayer is older than 25, evident in Gyomei awakening it along with gaining its benefits. Kokushibo surmised that due to this unique situation, Gyomei would die within a few hours of activating it, which came to pass after the Demon Slayer Corps', though it is possible that he died due to the injuries he sustained during the battle rather than the curse itself. Furthermore, Yoriichi Tsugikuni, the first user of the mark, managed to live past the age of 80, though this can also be explained by the fact that he was born with it.

Demon Slayers vs Daki and Gyutaro Demon Slayers vs Daki and Gyutaro was a battle that took place in the red-light district of Yoshiwara, Tokyo. It was a large and extensive battle that focused on the latest confrontation between the Demon Slayer Corps and the dual holders of Upper Rank Six of the Twelve Kizuki, Daki and Gyutaro. Prologue. For over one hundred years, the Yoshiwara red-light district of Tokyo had been the lair to two very powerful demons: the siblings Daki and Gyutaro. As the holders of Upper Rank Six and living hidden in a large urban population, they have proven themselves to be a great threat to humanity and have killed countless victims. Numerous Hashira have fallen to the two, with Daki and Gyutaro having claimed to have killed 7 and 15 respectively. In the latest intervention by the Demon Slayer Corps, the Sound Hashira, Tengen Uzui, is tasked with investigating the city for a demonic presence. He had initially sent his three kunoichi wives, Makio, Suma, and Hinatsuru, to probe about the area and send information back to him. When they suddenly stop informing him and have not been heard from since, he attempted to bring two female Demon Slayers to join him. He is instead accompanied by three Kanoe-ranked Demon Slayers; Tanjiro kamado, Zenitsu Agatsuma, and Inosuke Hashibira. Disguising, splitting, and assigning them to the three pleasure houses that his wives had been tasked with, they began their own separate investigations. While scanning the rooftops at night, Tengen does not see anything unusual but remains worried and uncertain, believing they may be fighting an Upper Rank demon. Inosuke, inside the Ogimoto House that Makio was in, discovers her room messy and dishevelled, and a demonic presence that moved inside the walls of the building, though he is impeded in his pursuit and failed to track it downstairs in time. Tanjiro, in the Tokito House that Suma was in, detected an unusual scent that only appeared at night, but he is unable to trace it without appearing suspicious. Zenitsu, inside the Kyogoku House that Hinatsuru was assigned to, initially struggles to look for evidence; he had failed to detect anything out of the ordinary with his hearing and the recent death of his House's madam caused everyone to remain tight-lipped and afraid. Trying once more, he detects the sound of a young girl crying inside of a broken and messy room. When he tried to ask her for any clues to what had happened, he is suddenly confronted by his House's Oiran, Warabihime. She angrily confronts him for entering her room unannounced but is instead accosted by Zenitsu when she hurts the girl inside. Warabihime then attacks him with an unexpected punch that knocks him unconscious, though she notes that in the split second before making contact, he had gone into a defensive posture, correctly deducing that Zenitsu is a Demon Slayer. Warabihime, later revealed to be Daki in disguise, then abducts him with her obi whilst he is alone. Inosuke and Tanjiro meet up to share information, only to be dismissed from the mission by Tengen, ashamed that his want to save his wives has led to Zenitsu going missing. Unwilling to abandon him, they coordinate a plan to re-arm and meet up to fight together. Going his own way, Tengen enters the Kyogoku House and threatens the master for information on the missing Zenitsu and Hinatsuru. The master, holding the kimono of his late wife, who was recently killed by Daki, tells him about Warabihime and Hinatsuru's location in the Kirimise. Tanjiro meets with the Oiran of the Tokito House, Koinatsu; he explains his true purpose in being in Yoshiwara and reassures her that he will save all who has gone missing. They bid each other farewell and Tanjiro leaves, only for Koinatsu to be met by Daki herself wanting to devour her. Inosuke, annoyed that Tanjiro has not followed the plan, decides to take action alone, re-arming himself for battle and continuing his investigation. Running through the halls of the Ogimoto House, he senses something in the floorboards and discovers a hole in the ground. Dislocating his joints to slither through a long tunnel, he finds himself in a large underground chamber. Elsewhere, Tengen locates the Kirimise, where sick prostitutes are housed. He frees and helps Hinatsuru, who had poisoned herself to leave the district but was prevented from doing so by Daki. He leaves her to recover and sprints across the buildings' rooftops to locate the demon. Battle. Rescuing the missing. Inosuke discovers the chamber littered with bones and housing obi with victims absorbed in them, including Suma, Makio, and Zenitsu, before he is confronted by a sentient obi. He fends it off easily as it is far too slow to prove a threat to him and begins to slice through the obi across the ceiling, freeing the people inside them. The obi questions how it will bypass his sharp senses when it suddenly spoken to by Daki; she orders it to capture him alive, as well as leaving the ten most attractive humans and letting the obi absorb the rest to strengthen its body. Inosuke tries to slash the sentient obi but it bends upon making contact, preventing a clean cut. He tries again with Beast Breathing, Sixth Fang: Palisade Bite but fails to cut through. It then leaves him alone to reabsorb the free victims. Before it does, the obi is pinned down by numerous kunai, hurled by Suma and Makio. Zenitsu, freed as well, suddenly enters the battle, using Thunder Breathing, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash, Sixfold to slice the ceiling obi apart to free even more victims. Shortly after, the ceiling of the chamber breaks opens; Tengen had detected the sound of the battle through the ground and has dug through the earth with his Sound Breathing. Emerging from the dust cloud, the Sound Hashira quickly scans the situation, breathes in, and uses his immense speed to slice the remaining obi apart in one attack, before reuniting with Suma and Makio. "Can I take on an Upper Rank alone?". At the same time, only after just leaving the Tokito House, Tanjiro detects the demonic scent again, returning to Koinatsu’s room to see her getting absorbed into Daki’s obi. He confronts the prideful Daki, who swats him out of the building for talking to her. The attack leaves Nezuko’s box damaged, leading him to set it aside to protect her. Leaping into the air to face Daki, he uses Water Breathing, Fourth Form: Striking Tide, Turbulent and is met by her numerous obi sashes. Fighting mid-air, he initially struggles to cut them but succeeds in slicing one off, saving Koinatsu. Daki punches him back to the ground, mildly amused at his efforts to attack her. She then hears a nearby explosion; annoyed, she asks Tanjiro on how many Demon Slayers there are, which he refuses to answer. She offers to spare him, pointing out that their short clash has already damaged his blade. Admitting that his body is simply unsuited to use Water Breathing, he nonetheless decides to continue fighting alone and change his style. Remembering Kyojuro Rengoku's encouragement to "set your heart ablaze", Tanjiro uses Hinokami Kagura: Raging Sun and slices Daki's incoming obi, before charging towards her and using Flame Dance, though he fails to make contact. She retaliates by stabbing him through the neck but he suddenly vanishes from view, using Hinokami Kagura: Fake Rainbow to obscure himself. Now behind Daki, he uses Fire Wheel to try and slice her neck. However, Daki effortlessly punches him away and causing him to miss. Still unused to using Hinokami Kagura, he begins to feel the strain on his body in using consecutive forms, giving Daki the chance to charge at him, with her obi dragging across the ground to shred him. Using Recovery Breathing, he narrowly avoids getting hit. Daki then uses her obi in consecutive slashes, leaving him on the defensive. He forces his body temperature to increase by using Hinokami Kagura's breathing pattern, enabling him to utilize it for longer periods. She engages him again, this time, using her obi to parry his swings and charging towards Tanjiro simultaneously to attack him. As they fight, new obi suddenly begins to adhere to her, having escaped from the underground chamber through the hole made by Tengen. Tanjiro then attempts to swing at the Upper Rank, only to miss due to her new speed. Daki is pleased that her obi has given her information regarding a Hashira's presence, as her hair turns white and she retains her full strength once again. A man then walks out onto the street, angered at the racket happening outside of his House and demanding they leave the district. Tanjiro grows worried that their battle has attracted the attention of civilians. Refusing to answer to a human, Daki retaliates by launching her obis in a rapid and long-range slash, slicing through buildings and causing numerous casualties, as well as cutting Tanjiro in the shoulder. Daki walks away satisfied but is confronted by Tanjiro; dismissing his words and stating he can die and rot with the other casualties, the Demon Slayer seethes with anger and leaps onto the building to stop her from escaping, refusing to let a callous loss of life go unpunished. "What do you take life for, exactly?". Tanjiro furiously confronts Daki about why she would kill humans weaker than her, asking what she found so enjoyable about murder. His rage and appearance causes her to see a vision; an older Demon Slayer asking the same question with the same cold anger. Daki responds that she has forgotten her memories as a human and embraced life as a demon, claiming they can do anything they want. Accepting this answer, he lunges towards the demon, who quickly reacts with Blood Demon Art: Eight-Layered Obi Slash, believing he will be unable to cut through her more powerful interweaving attack. Tanjiro instead uses Hinokami Kagura: Burning Bones, Summer Sun, slicing right through the wave of obi and causing her to feel a burning pain, as well as slowing her healing. Daki tries using her obi in consecutive slashes again but Tanjiro effortlessly fends them off with his new speed and sharper skills. She leaps to a new building in an attempt to save herself, only for him to chase the demon onto the same roof and lunge towards her, swinging his sword into her neck. He seemingly makes contact and her head falls, only for Daki to reveal that she has turned her neck into an obi, softening his swing and preventing decapitation. Angered at almost dying, she grows more obi to use; Tanjiro realizes that dodging them will cause more destruction, yet is surprised to see them moving so slowly. Daki launches them to slice him apart but he parries them away, causing them to converge on one side and allowing him to pin them down with his blade. He pulls them taut, preventing Daki from manipulating them freely. Despite the obi being pinned down, she claims she can simply take control again as soon as Tanjiro releases his hold, only for the Demon Slayer to pull away his sword and free the obi. He then speeds towards Upper Six and slices through the obi in one fluid attack, Daki now too slow to even react. Before his blade can reach her neck, Tanjiro begins to tremble and collapses in front of her; he had forgotten to maintain the breathing pattern during his assault and his body experiences the toil of using such power at once. As he struggles to breathe, the Upper Rank mocks him for being so weak, claiming that she is beginning to feel pity seeing such a pathetic sight. Nezuko vs Daki. Before Daki can decapitate Tanjiro in retaliation, Nezuko appears behind her and destroys her head with a powerful kick. Enraged by her brother's nearly dying and remembering her family's murder, she readies herself to engage Daki, while the Upper Rank sees that she is the demon Muzan has asked her to kill. Nezuko tries to kick her again but Daki slices off her leading leg and cuts into her torso from the other side, severing an arm as well. She hurls her into a nearby house, trapping Nezuko beneath the debris. Daki offers to stop fighting her and instead absorb Nezuko into her obi to instead be killed by the sun, only for Nezuko to free herself and stand up. Daki becomes confused seeing her stand as she was sure her leg was severed; she then grows concerned when Nezuko instantly regrows her severed arm, her regeneration now on par with that of an Upper Rank. Nezuko changes her appearance for battle, growing larger and attaining vine-like markings throughout her body. Nezuko rushes the Upper Rank, leading Daki severs her right arm and leg in anticipation. However, her limbs grow back instantly and she slams her foot into Daki's back, pinning her to the ground and piercing her torso. She then stomps off her arms and repeatedly kicks her face, causing Daki to desperately use her obis in a rapid flurry that slices Nezuko apart, splattering her in blood. Daki backs away and slashes the young demon repeatedly, but Nezuko is able to maintain her form by congealing her blood. The smears of Nezuko's blood then ignite, setting Daki on fire and causing the demon to relive a traumatic moment in her past. The Upper Rank scream in terror as she is burned, while Nezuko heals herself and stares in delight. She leaps into the air and slams her foot down onto Daki, now burnt and unable to heal the damage. She kicks Upper Six down to the ground before launching her away down the street. As she hurtles uncontrollably, the young demon chases her down and kicks her through several houses, Daki now too stunned and traumatized to fight back. As Nezuko moves forward to finish off Daki, she smells the blood of an injured girl. She struggles to hold back the urge, but in her new demonic form, she succumbs to the scent of blood and tries to kill her. Tanjiro enters the building and forces his scabbard into her mouth as a muzzle. He apologizes for forcing her to join the fight and begs her to go to sleep. Nezuko leaps to an upper storey of the building, while he struggles to hold her down. Daki appears, still burned and enraged that her opponent was able to use a Blood Demon Art. With bystanders present, Daki now before him, and Nezuko still struggling to break free, Tanjiro is unable to think of a plan. A new threat appears. Daki prepares to launch her obi to slice everyone apart, only for the Sound Hashira to suddenly enter and slice the incoming attack, saving everyone. Tengen looks at Nezuko and chides Tanjiro for allowing her to transform, in spite of showing her resistance to humans during the meeting with Kagaya. Daki is delighted to see her target in front of her, only for him to refute her threats and claim she is no Upper Rank. Daki is aghast at this but her head suddenly falls off, decapitated by Tengen earlier but unable to register it till now. Though Daki is neutralized, Tengen reminds Tanjiro that the battle is not over, ordering him to calm Nezuko down. When he jokingly suggests singing a lullaby, Nezuko kicks herself and her brother out onto the streets. Tanjiro remembers something and begins to sing a lullaby that their mother had sang to them as kids. Though Nezuko continues to fight back, she relents and the words get to her, and she remembers a moment she had with Kie. Reminiscing on that time, Nezuko begins to cry and her body shrinks back down to normal, now able to sleep and heal. When Tengen decides to move on, Daki threatens him for having the audacity to behead her. He ignores her threats and tells her to die "unflashy". She confronts him over his statement that she is not an Upper Rank, though he remains unconvinced by seeing her holding her severed head. Daki claims she is Upper Six and will get stronger but Tengen does not listen. With this last denial of her strength, the now emotional Daki begins to cry, whining that she is truly an Upper Rank. Tengen, shocked seeing a demon throwing a tantrum, quickly realizes that she is still alive despite being fully beheaded and stays cautious. As she continues to cry and deny that she was defeated, she calls out to her brother. Gyutaro suddenly emerges from Daki's back, forcing Tengen into action; he attempts to swing his blades at the new demon's neck but misses completely. Stunned, he turns around to see Gyutaro comforting Daki, who calms her down and heals the burn on her face. Tengen tries to attack again but the demon dodges his swings and cuts him in the side of the head. Gyutaro compliments his opponent’s looks, claiming that he must receive much attention from women and scratching himself in jealous anger. Angered at the Demon Slayers hurting Daki, Gyutaro hurls his kamas at the Hashira, narrowly missing his mark to threaten him. The kamas are seen by Tanjiro; wondering if there is a new demon now, he is joined by Inosuke and Zenitsu, who had lost track of Tengen but detected the sound of the battle to join. Tanjiro takes the chance to take Nezuko away to safety. Learning that Tengen’s looks have garnered him three wives, Gyutaro grows more enraged and unleashes Blood Demon Art: Flying Blood Sickles. Tengen quickly hurls explosive beads and they detonate upon hitting the floor, allowing him to escape the blood blades and free the civilians. Gyutaro then wills his blades to attack the Hashira, forcing him to fight back as they converge on him. Using his hearing, he assesses the house for any survivors and finds no one else but the demons; with this, he hurls beads into the air and uses his blades to activate them, destroying the house and knocking the demons back, as well as Inosuke and Zenitsu inadvertently. "“We’re going to win! Us the Demon Slayers!”". Seeing the siblings unharmed, Tengen mutters that this battle will not be easy, while Gyutaro notes that he and Daki are one body. The demons and the Demon Slayer trade barbs over their clashing beliefs, with Tengen refusing to accept their words that he is special over letting lives slip through him. Remembering his brutal past as a shinobi and his acceptance by Kagaya for his difficult path, he becomes reinvigorated with his willingness to do anything for the master. Gyutaro mocks him for acting confident despite being poisoned but the Hashira suddenly charges towards them, separating the two by kicking Daki up. The siblings attempt to retaliate but Tengen releases more beads to defend himself; Gyutaro dodges them but Daki accidentally hits one, leading her to be beheaded again by Tengen. He tries to behead Gyutaro by extending the reach of his blades but he only manages to slit his neck. Tengen is then joined by Inosuke, Zenitsu, and Tanjiro. The demons mock them for believing they can win with their main strength in Tengen now poisoned, shocking Tanjiro. However, the Sound Hashira proclaims that they will succeed by decapitating them simultaneously, while Gyutaro states that they will fail anyway as numerous Hashira have fallen to them. Daki attacks Tengen with her obi but is intercepted by Zenitsu using his Thunder Breathing, the attack's momentum launches both of them into the air. Tanjiro tries to call out to him but Inosuke states that he and Zenitsu will take on Daki while he and Tengen battle Gyutaro. When confronted for their murders, the siblings, speaking as one, state their belief that they are justified in taking from those better off than them, while Gyutaro implants his right eye into Daki, allowing them to share power and vision. Tanjiro tries to pre-emptively attack Gyutaro but the Upper Rank rushes forward and moves to stab him in the jaw, forcing Tengen to fling him back to save him. As the two clash, Daki’s obi begins to punch through the ceiling, forcing Tanjiro and Tengen to defend themselves. Gyutaro, sharing Daki’s vision, uses the obi to hold back the Demon Slayers. She then uses more to fend off Zenitsu and Inosuke; the latter unwittingly taunts Daki into attacking harder, causing her to launch the obi into the house, impeding Tengen from fighting Gyutaro effectively. The Hashira deploys more explosive beads to stop the onslaught but Gyutaro cuts him twice as they fight. Gyutaro uses Blood Demon Art: Flying Blood Sickles and launches them at the Sound Hashira, forcing Tanjiro to hold back the blood blades, using Water Breathing’s flexibility for better defence. Tengen then uses Sound Breathing, Fifth Form: String Performance, destroying the blood blades and forcing Gyutaro into the streets. He then decides to assist Daki and launches more blood blades at Zenitsu and Inosuke, preventing them from reaching her, while Tengen and Tanjiro struggle to get close to Gyutaro with his aggressive attacking and Daki's obi intercepting them. Defeating an Upper Rank. Watching the battle from above, a recovered Hinatsuru uses a crossbow to launch wisteria-laced kunai at Gyutaro; though he blocks most of the knives with Blood Demon Art: Rampant Arc Rampage, a stray blade hits him in the neck, leaving him unable to heal when Tengen lunges in and cuts off his legs. Tanjiro gets close enough to swing his blade into his neck but the demon forces the knife out of his body, allowing him to regenerate his legs instantly. Gyutaro uses Blood Demon Art: Rotating Circular Slashes, Flying Blood Sickles, forming a spinning wave of blood blades that forces Tengen to shove Tanjiro away to safety. He uses Sound Breathing, Fourth Form: Constant Resounding Slashes to destroy the incoming attack but Gyutaro vanishes. He calls out to Hinatsuru just as obi encircles him; she hurls Kunai at the obi to save him but Gyutaro suddenly appears and grabs Hinatsuru by the mouth. Tengen desperately yells for her to be left alone just as Tanjiro sees the situation. Despite his heavy wounds and exhaustion, he forces himself to move and reach her, utilizing Water Breathing and Hinokami Kagura together to reach the demon. Tanjiro cut off his hand to free her but Gyutaro rushes forward to attack him; Tengen, grateful of the Demon Slayer's actions, joins the clash and swings his blade into the Upper Rank's neck. At the same time, Inosuke and Zenitsu continue to struggle against Daki's overwhelming obi; the former sees Tengen and Tanjiro about to behead their target and tries to rush Daki in desperation, though he is forced back by the obi's sheer number. Zenitsu reminds him what is vital is for demons to be decapitated, not done simultaneously; obi encircles him but he uses his Thunder Breathing to free himself. Using his kamas, Gyutaro stops Tanjiro's and Tengen's blades from hitting him, adhering flesh to the metal to lock them in place; Tengen swings his second blade but the demon twists his head to bite down onto it. Using Rotating Circular Slashes, he tries to mince the Demon Slayers together; Tengen throws himself and Gyutaro off of the roof, saving Tanjiro and Hinatsuru. They call out to Tengen but are warned by Inosuke as Daki's obi converges on them. He and Zenitsu hold off the obi as Tanjiro, seeing Tengen battling Gyutaro alone, joins in to help them and Hinatsuru retreats to safety. As Daki taunts them for their slowing movements, Tanjiro informs Inosuke that her neck needs to be slice in different directions. Taking this in, he offers himself as the one to do it, while Tanjiro and Zenitsu protect him on his path. The trio regroup to one spot and ready themselves for the attack; with Inosuke in the lead, Tanjiro and Zenitsu fend off the obi in his path. Inosuke strengthens his muscles and uses Beast Breathing, Eighth Fang: Explosive Rush, charging towards the Upper Rank. Tanjiro runs beside him and uses Water Breathing, Third Form: Flowing Dance, while Zenitsu uses Thunder Breathing, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash, Eightfold. Together, they move in front of their leading attacker and parry all of the obi to clear his way. Inosuke sprints towards Daki, who tries to hit him with her obi but is unable to make contact as he is moving, ignoring minor cuts to reach her. He swings both his blades into her neck and uses Sixth Fang: Palisade Bite to successfully saw off Daki's head. Inosuke runs off with her head to prevent it from reattaching to her body; the obi attempt to grab him but he evades them and runs across the district, while Tanjiro and Zenitsu move off to aid Tengen. Gyutaro then appears behind Inosuke and stabs him through the chest. Tanjiro grows horrified at his sudden appearance and looks for Tengen, finding him unconscious on the ground with his left hand severed. He freezes in the moment, forcing Zenitsu to push him off the roof as the obi launches a rapid slash that devastates their surroundings. As he apologizes to everyone for his lapse in judgement, he sees a vision of Nezuko, who begs him to stop feeling guilty for anything that doesn't go their way, asking he stop apologizing for everything and to instead look on ahead past it. He awakens from seeing the vision to find the whole of Yoshiwara up in flames, and Tanjiro can only wonder if the residents escaped safely. He is relieved to see Nezuko still asleep and decides he must do what he can, only for Gyutaro to appear before him, amused to see the Demon Slayer still alive. With Daki now healed, Gyutaro points out how unfortunately lucky he is; Inosuke lies in a pool of blood motionless, Zenitsu is struggling to free himself from fallen debris, and Tengen has been defeated by his poison in the end. Deriding the Demon Slayers as disgraceful, he makes a point to torment Tanjiro for being the sole survivor; Gyutaro then sees Nezuko and ask if she is a relative. Tanjiro, terrified and unsure in seeing him standing by without killing him, wonders how he can survive if he cannot even hold his sword. Tanjiro answers that Nezuko is his younger sister, amusing Gyutaro that he is unable able to protect her, angering him; he believes that her being a demon means he cannot protect her as a human, before breaking two of Tanjiro's fingers to drive his point across. Whilst unarmed, he repeatedly insults Tanjiro for being weak and goads the Demon Slayer into killing him. Tanjiro instead runs away with Nezuko's box and feebly attempts to escape, causing Daki and Gyutaro to laugh seeing his crushed spirit. The Upper Rank chases after him and kicks Tanjiro into a burning building, where he narrowly avoids getting crushed by the burning debris. He corners Tanjiro at the end of the street, who throws small pieces of rubble and a sachet at the demon, only to be violently kicked in the stomach, vomiting blood as a result. With Tanjiro at his mercy, Gyutaro points out that he enjoys anything filthy and pathetic, touching the scar on his forehead and admiring its weird appearance. He proposes that he become a demon like him, willing to spare him should he transform and threatening to end his life and Nezuko's should he choose otherwise. Tanjiro looks up in response; Gyutaro believes that humans look to the sky when they grieve to stop their tears from flowing, only for Tanjiro to declare that he had been waiting for this moment, head-butting the demon in the face. Gyutaro laughs at his weak attempt to hurt him but finds he is unable to stand up, surprising him and Daki; he discovers that as Tanjiro hit him, he had also stabbed him in the leg with a wisteria-laced kunai. Unable to get up, Gyutaro curses Tanjiro for his unyielding resolve in spite of the odds, as he uses Hinokami Kagura once more and brings his blade down, cutting into Gyutaro's neck. "...with every ounce of strength I have!". Daki attempts to intervene and sends her obi after Tanjiro, only for Zenitsu to break free from being pinned by debris, using his Thunder Breathing to slice and launch himself off her obi. She tries to hit him but he evades the obi easily and prepares to use Thunder Breathing, First Form. She believes she will be able to attack him after seeing the form numerous times, only for Zenitsu to extend his attack to a new height; Thunderclap and Flash, Godspeed. Using her obi as a launch pad, Zenitsu draws his sword and blitzes Daki, who is completely unable to react to the new attack; she had turned her neck into an obi in anticipation but the blade begins to cut through; Zenitsu, having used Godspeed earlier to escape the rubble, knows this is his only chance to defeat her. Due to its high durability, Tanjiro struggles to cut further into his opponent's neck, while the demon pulls out the kunai and heals from the poison. He forms blood blades that repel the blade and force Tanjiro back as he heals his neck completely. Now entirely enraged, he summons even more blood blades and launches them at the Demon Slayer, while fighting with him simultaneously. Tanjiro is unable to fight back and cannot get close to Gyutaro. As the demon swings his kama into Tanjiro's eye, it is suddenly blocked by Tengen, before repelling the Upper Rank with an explosive swing of his blade. Confused to see him up despite believing he was dead, Gyutaro surmises that Tengen had used his muscles to stop his heart, slowing the circulation of his poison. As a still shocked Tanjiro calls out to the Hashira, he proudly states he has now developed his Musical Score technique to allow them to win, before lunging at Upper Six. Gyutaro summons a wave of blood blades to kill Tengen but he uses his enhanced hearing and Sound Breathing to read the attack as a song; he develops a pattern that allows him to overwhelm and destroy the blood blades with precise slashes, as he makes his way to Gyutaro. He then jumps up and swings both blades into the ground, creating an explosion that forces Gyutaro back to save himself. Angered that his attack was defeated by a man with one arm, Gyutaro leaps toward Tengen, who does the same in response. They clash head-on and form a massive explosion, before they race across Yoshiwara while swinging and parrying the other's attacks. Gyutaro kicks Tengen away from him and generates another wave of blood blades, but they are destroyed as they get close, as Tengen is now able to read the attack easily. Eventually, they hit a standstill and resort to swinging their weapons at each other in the hope of making contact, speeding up as they attack each other and creating numerous explosions and blood blades that engulfs the city streets. Tengen and Gyutaro continue to move across the battlefield and fend away the other's blows, while Tanjiro keeps up with them, using his Hinokami Kagura to speed himself up to their level. Knowing that Tengen will hit his limit first, he realizes that he will eventually need to make a move. Gyutaro then stabs his kama into one of Tengen's sword chain links, breaking it and severing the weapon into two, before piercing the Hashira's stomach and slicing upwards, cutting across his face and eye. Tengen ignores the pain and leaps forward to stab Gyutaro with his last blade, signalling Tanjiro to deliver the final blow. Tanjiro jumps up and tries to reach Gyutaro's neck, but the demon anticipates his move and stabs him in the bottom jaw, believing that his poison will kill them both. He remains defiant and slams his sword into the Upper Rank's neck. With the final remnants of his strength put into his sword, Tanjiro forces himself to push beyond his limits; the scar on his head suddenly becomes a fiery mark. With his new power, he slices deeper into Gyutaro, who curses himself for getting beheaded by him; he nonetheless remains hopeful that he can stay alive given that Daki is somewhere and still needs to be beheaded by them. Daki still remains in the grasp of Zenitsu's blade, racing across the sky with the momentum of his Godspeed. However, he no longer has the strength to cut further; she takes the chance to kill him once more and grows more obi to slice Zenitsu to pieces. Before they can make contact, the obi is suddenly destroyed by Inosuke, shocking Daki. He warns her not to underestimate his flexibility and the ease in moving his own organs, as well as stating that growing in the mountains has made him impervious to poisons. He joins Zenitsu and brings both his blades onto her neck, while Daki screams and begs for Gyutaro to do something. As his neck is nearly sliced through completely, Gyutaro tries to use Rotating Circular Slashes to stop them. Using the last portion of power put into their swords, Zenitsu, Inosuke, and Tanjiro push through and successfully decapitate the dual holders of Upper Rank Six. The demons' head roll along the ground till they stop in front of each other. Aftermath. Suma, Makio, and Hinatsuru watch the demons' decapitation from a building's roof; Suma is overjoyed at the demons' defeat and asked Hinatsuru to look, believing she is dead, much to Makio's chagrin. However, Hinatsuru remains uncertain of the outcome. Tengen, struggling to breathe, suddenly sees that Gyutaro's body is about to form blood blades. He warns Tanjiro of the danger but he cannot hear him, with Gyutaro's poison causing his vision to blur and his hearing to weaken. The Sound Hashira yells for everyone to run but the demon's body suddenly releases an enormous burst of Rotating Circular Slashes, catching everyone in the epicentre and destroying the city of Yoshiwara. However, Nezuko's box is thrown into the air by the attack and she uses her Blood Demon Art to burn the blood blades away. Later, Tanjiro awakens to find the city is nothing more than a pile of burnt rubble, before reuniting with Nezuko. They hear Zenitsu calling for help in the distance; Tanjiro, now too weak to even stand up, is carried by Nezuko to take him there. Zenitsu, who is now awaken and terrified to find his body is racked with pain, then leads them to Inosuke. Seeing him dying to the poison and with no help available, Tanjiro laments that his own life was spare, only for Nezuko to burn away the poison with her blood. Inosuke wakes up asking for food and Tanjiro tearfully embraces him. Elsewhere, Tengen is slowly dying to the poison, surrounded by his wives. He tries to give his last words but is drowned out by Suma's wailing and Makio's attacking her in annoyance. Nezuko interrupts their grieving and touches Tengen, setting him on fire to burn the poison and saving the Sound Hashira. Knowing to finish off the demons, Tanjiro and Nezuko set out to find them somewhere among the remains of the city. They find a pool of Gyutaro's blood and he takes a sample for use in Tamayo's research. Her cat then appears to retrieve the blood before vanishing. Eventually, they hear yelling coming from Daki and Gyutaro in the distance, who are blaming each other for their own defeat by the Demon Slayers. The fight gets personal when Daki accuses Gyutaro of being too ugly to be related to her and he retaliates by claiming that she would have been long dead without him since she is too weak. Tanjiro, hurt to see them arguing in their last moments, rushes over to stop their fight, begging them to reconcile before they die. As she fades to ash, Daki begins to cry and begs for Gyutaro to save her, causing him to call out to her with her human name, Ume. Before his own death, Gyutaro reminisces on their lives and how they came to be, before eventually reconciling with Daki in the afterlife, both siblings entering Hell and promising to never be apart again. The Serpent Hashira, Obanai Iguro, arrives after the battle, sarcastically praising Tengen for defeating an Upper Rank, though making emphasis that Upper Six is still the lowest of the Uppers. He wonders what Tengen will do next having lost an eye and hand, only to be told that he intends to retire. With mounting losses and less-skilled new Demon Slayers, Obanai orders Tengen to retain his role as the Sound Hashira but is ignored; Tengen instead claims that Tanjiro has shown great potential in replacing him, surprising the Serpent Hashira. In an unknown location, Kagaya receives the news of Upper Six's defeat and is overjoyed, praising the Demon Slayers who fought in the battle and believing that Muzan's own defeat is close. Elsewhere, in the Infinity Castle, Akaza has been summoned to the dimensional space and immediately realizes that an Upper Rank has been killed.

Demon Slayers vs Enmu The Demon Slayers vs Enmu was a battle that took place on the Mugen Train. It focuses on the battle between Demon Slayers Tanjiro Kamado, Zenitsu Agatsuma and Inosuke Hashibira, the demon Nezuko Kamado and the Flame Hashira Kyojuro Rengoku against Lower Rank One Enmu. Prologue. After reports of numerous disappearances on the Mugen Train, the Demon Slayer Corps assigned the Flame Hashira, Kyojuro Rengoku, with the mission to hunt down the responsible. Eventually, as the number of disappearances grew to over forty, the Demon Slayers Tanjiro Kamado, Zenitsu Agatsuma, and Inosuke Hashibira were sent as well to aid Kyojuro. Nezuko Kamado also joined as her brother believe it was better that they stayed together at all times. As the sun sets, the trio climb aboard the train and meet with Kyojuro, who explains the situation at hand. Moments later, two hidden demons emerge from the train, hidden via their Blood Demon Arts. However, the Flame Hashira proved more than capable of dealing with the creatures and was able to protect all of the passengers. As the night drags on, all four Demon Slayers soon fell into a deep sleep, experiencing strong and vivid dreams. In reality, they have fallen into the Blood Demon Art of Enmu, Lower One of the Twelve Kizuki. By mixing his blood into the ink of their tickets and having the Train Conductor punch them to activate his spell, Enmu was able to manipulate their dreams to keep them pacified and unconscious, while he sent four willing passengers to enter their dreams and cripple them. However, Kyojuro's intensely strong spirit was able to protect himself from his intruder but he nonetheless remained asleep. Meanwhile, Tanjiro himself began to notice strange things within his dream, such as speaking of Nezuko's transformation during the time it never happened, seeing her wooden box at a glance but finding it has vanished from view, and eventually, a reflection of himself begs him to wake up. It reminded him that he is in fact still on the Mugen Train and needs to wake up to fight of a nearby danger. Despite realizing he is in a dream, Tanjiro remained trapped as he could not find a way to escape, and he remained unwilling to leave the family he loved so dearly. Sensing trouble with her brother and seeing the others asleep, Nezuko, who is unaffected by Enmu's Blood Demon Art, attempted to wake up her brother. After headbutting him and sustaining a small gash, she became distressed and tried again, inadvertently activating her own Blood Demon Art, Exploding Blood. While he remained asleep, Tanjiro was able to sense Nezuko in danger and began regaining consciousness. After accepting the reality of his family's deaths and being guided by a vision of his father telling him to do what is necessary to awaken, Tanjiro was able to find the resolve and sliced his throat in his dream, successfully waking up. Seeing his friends still asleep, he discovers the passengers sent by Enmu and quickly dispatches them; to his surprise, the boy sent to kill him spoke of his regret in wanting to harm such a pure soul, and Tanjiro was able to forgive him after seeing his desperation to escape his life and live in a dream. Tasking Nezuko protecting the others, Tanjiro detected a strong demonic scent on the roof of the training, climbing up the carriage and coming face to face with Enmu. Lower One becomes perplexed at how he managed to escape his dream, mentioning it was meant to make him happy and he could have showed him one depicted his family's gruesome deaths. Battle. Tanjiro is infuriated by Enmu's comments and immediately readies the Water Breathing, Tenth Form: Constant Flux in order to behead Enmu as he unleashes his Blood Demon Art: Whispers of Forced Unconscious Hypnosis. Enmu tells Tanjiro to go to sleep as his hand mouth releases the Blood Demon Art, forcing Tanjiro to lose consciousness and sleep. However, the Demon Slayer quickly regains consciousness and keeps engaging the Lower Rank with the Water Breathing. Enmu continues using his Blood Demon Art to make Tanjiro fall asleep but keeps waking up from him killing himself in his dream. This keeps happening until Enmu decides to make Tanjiro see his family angry and disappointed at him for them believing that he let them die from a demon. With his own siblings, mother and even his father insulting him, this angers Tanjiro knowing that his family would never badmouth him under any circumstance. Because of this, Tanjiro is able to behead Enmu using the Water Breathing, Tenth Form: Constant Flux. As Tanjiro beheads Enmu, he comments that there was no reaction from Enmu being beheaded leading him to believe that whether he himself was in a dream or if he was just overall weaker than the previous Twelve Kizuki member he fought, Rui. Enmu however notes that 'that person' commanded him to kill Tanjiro Kamado along with the other Hashira, and he points out that the Demon Slayer's existence makes him seethe in anger. As he is saying this, a huge bundle of flesh connects Enmu's disembodied head to the ceiling of the train. Tanjiro looks in disbelief and fear as Enmu tells him that even a toddler can figure out why he won't die even if he is decapitated by a Nichirin Blade. He describes that this is not his actual body but that he merged with the entire train with it being his flesh and bones. As Tanjiro tries to cut Enmu, his "head" fuses with the train before that happens. Tanjiro panicking, immediately tries to go back to the passengers to defend them despite him stating that he can only protect two carriages at best. He shouts Kyojuro and the others, begging them to wake up in order to defend the passengers. Suddenly, a faint noise keeps building up from inside the Mugen Train, that being Inosuke Hashibira. Relieved to see him awake, Tanjiro tells Inosuke to take care of the passengers coming to the latter's frustration due to his dream. Inosuke then jumps back into the crevice that he created and unleashes his Beast Breathing, Fifth Fang: Crazy Cutting wanting admiration from the passengers when they wake up, as Tanjiro goes to another carriage through a window he cuts off one of the fleshy ingrowths with the Water Breathing, First Form: Water Surface Slash. On another part of the Infinty Train, Nezuko Kamado readies herself to defend the nearby passengers from Enmu's ingrowths by slashing, smashing and punching them. Soon after, one of the ingrowths becomes to close to a passenger so Nezuko puts her arm in between the two, taking a hit. As the ingrowth grasps Nezuko's arm, she tries to slash it off with her nails but another ingrowth grips her other arm and soon both of her legs, completely constricting her. Before the ingrowths rip Nezuko apart, a sudden flash of lightning coming from multiple nearby carriages light up and destroy all the ingrowths constricting Nezuko. The flash turns out to be Zenitsu still fallen asleep but with his natural instincts kicking in, with this being said he quickly slashes and destroys all the surrounding ingrowths with his Thunder Breathing, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash, Sixfold. As he finishes the technique, Zenitsu comments to Nezuko that he will do anything to protect her from harm but soon loses focus and goofily finishes his sentence. On the other side of the train, Tanjiro notices the sound of lightning behind him and questions if Zenitsu and Kyojuro have woken up. Kyojuro is shown shaming himself for staying asleep as the hundreds of passengers were of near-death states as he charges and slices the train's interior with his Flame Breathing. The sheer impact of his techniques shakes the whole carriage and even nearby ones out of the rail track, enough to make Tanjiro and the others lose their footing. As the Mugen Train finishes derailing, Kyojuro goes into the same carriage where Tanjiro is and explains that there are eight total carriages and he will defend the back five and Zenitsu and Nezuko will defend the other three. With that out of the way, he requests Tanjiro and Inosuke to first defend Zenitsu and Nezuko and then find a weak spot of the Lower Rank in order to kill it. Tanjiro comes in and saves Inosuke at the nick of time from the ingrowths by using the Water Breathing, Sixth Form: Whirlpool as the chunks of flesh cut off fly far off from the train. Enmu is then heard screeching in pain by everyone even on the very back carriages. From hearing this, Tanjiro believes that the "weak spot" is somewhere nearby and requests Inosuke to open the floor that they are standing on if the Lower Rank's weak spot is residing there. The latter gets frustrated for being commanded around by his "subordinates" and uses his Beast Breathing, Second Fang: Slice towards the floor, revealing large vertebrae-like bones. Tanjiro sees Enmu's neckbone and immediately uses the Water Breathing, Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin in order to behead the Lower Rank but the latter protects his neckbone with flesh before Tanjiro's technique can make contact with the vertebrae. The flesh that defended the neckbone quickly expands in all directions with fleshy hand-like appendages flailing around. Tanjiro grabs hold of the train engineer and with Inosuke quickly leap to a safe distance as the flesh continues expanding into the structure near similar to an arena. Tanjiro quickly requests Inosuke to help him out in order for their Breathing techniques to combine in order to inflict some harm onto the neckbone but before they manage to do that, Enmu unleashes his Blood Demon Art: Eyes of Forced Unconscious Sleep, forcing Tanjiro to fall asleep constantly. Upon seeing the Blood Demon Art, Tanjiro quickly tells Inosuke to cut his own neck inside the dream in order to wake up. As Tanjiro keeps on waking up and falling asleep, at one point he doesn't know what is reality anymore and positions his Nichirin Blade near his neck ready to cut his own throat in the real world. Before he could do so, Inosuke quickly grabs Tanjiro's wrist and drags it toward the ground to stop him from killing himself. Inosuke informs Tanjiro that this is reality and continues slashing the ingrowths with the numerous eyeballs with the kanji for etched on their irises. From this, Tanjiro realizes that due to Inosuke's boar mask it's incredibly hard for one to know the point of view for the latter. However, as he comments to himself about Inosuke's perception, the train engineer rushes in with one of Enmu's flesh made awls and begs them to not stop the dream. Tanjiro however takes the blow from the engineer to his abdomen and chops his neck to knock him out. Inosuke asks Tanjiro if he is alright, and the latter responds that he is. Before they can communicate anymore, dozens of ingrowths lash out at the two Demon Slayers as they constantly slash at the ingrowths for defense and offense. As Inosuke falls towards the engine of the train, he grinds both his Nichirin Blades on the dozens of eyeballs from Enmu's Blood Demon Art and with the momentum of the fall along with his swordsmanship, Inosuke uses his Beast Breathing, Fourth Fang: Slice 'n' Dice to cut away the flesh that protects the neckbone for Tanjiro. With Enmu's neckbone exposed, Tanjiro pleads to his father Tanjuro to help him defeat the final Lower Rank as he transitions between the Water Breathing to the Hinokami Kagura. With that, he uses the Hinokami Kagura: Clear Blue Sky, severing Enmu's head, truly killing him. With Enmu beheaded, he profusely shrieks in pain and horror as he unleashes his ingrowths to attempt to consume all the 200 passengers onboard presumably to help accelerate his regeneration in order for him to reattach his severed head. They were thankfully stopped by Kyojuro Rengoku and Zenitsu Agatsuma with their respective Breathing Styles. Aftermath. The entire Mugen Train completely derails as the Lower Rank continues shrieking and the ingrowths flail everywhere. Tanjiro begs to Inosuke and the others to defend the passengers at all costs, however his comments soon stop as the hemorrhaging in his abdomen continues. Inosuke concerned at Tanjiro asks if his wound is okay with the latter responding that it is okay and that he should focus more on the passengers. Panicking, Tanjiro realizes that if he dies the train engineer will be a murderer due to his abdomen wound being evidence for his "murder". As the Mugen Train collapses onto the terrain, Tanjiro tries his hardest to grasp the train engineer but to no avail. Thankfully, his impact onto the ground was rather soft due to him rolling because of the momentum of the train.

Demon Slayers vs Tanjiro Kamado Demon Slayers vs Tanjiro Kamado is the final battle between humanity and demons, taking place outside the destroyed Infinity Castle. It focuses on the battle between the last surviving remnants of the Demon Slayer Corps against the newly transformed Tanjiro Kamado. Prologue. The Demon Slayers have managed to successfully expose Muzan Kibutsuji to the sun after a night-long until dawn. But the victory is pyrrhic; despite Muzan's death, nearly the entire Demon Slayer Corp is wiped out and the battle resulted in the eventual deaths of the Hashiras Gyomei Himejima, Obanai Iguro and Mitsuri Kanroji. The battle also led to the death of Tamayo and the remaining survivors all critically wounded. As his armour of flesh burns away, Muzan sees Tanjiro Kamado inside, having been enveloped with him during his attempt to save himself from the sunlight. Tanjiro is no longer breathing and his heart has stopped. Muzan remembers his past, having been close to death ever since he was born and his only dream was to conquer the sun as a demon to live forever. Recalling the words of Kagaya Ubuyashiki of human thoughts being the only true immortal thing, Muzan tears up and accepts he could never achieve immortality. But instead of accepting its true meaning, he decides his thoughts are immortal and instead of him, Tanjiro could be the one to carry out his will. He sees that despite his body's lack of movement, some of his cells remain alive. With the last of his power, he pumps all his blood into Tanjiro's body, and as he himself begins to disintegrate, he tells Tanjiro that he will become the strongest demon of all, having Nezuko's immortality to sunlight and unable to be killed due to being the only one able to perform Sun Breathing. As the last portions of Muzan's body disappear, he voices that he believes that Tanjiro will not die and in his stead, he will kill the Demon Slayers. Battle. Upon becoming a demon, Tanjiro recovers from the poison that caused the growth on his face and regenerates his lost arm and eye. As Muzan predicted, Tanjiro shows resistance to sunlight when he faces off against Giyu Tomioka. He goes to attack Inosuke Hashibira, who saved Giyu, only to be embraced by a panicking and saddened Nezuko. Nezuko tearfully begs her brother to stop so they can return back home, and Tanjiro manages to temporarily calm himself down after he unconsciously bites Nezuko's shoulder. However, as Inosuke lands several punches to Tanjiro in frustration, Tanjiro further evolves his demon form and grows bone appendages similar to Muzan's. Nezuko continues to beg to Tanjiro to not lose himself to Muzan but he continues to mindlessly attack the Demon Slayer Corps, swinging one of his bone appendages towards Zenitsu. Giyu saves Zenitsu and a few Kakushi using the Water Breathing, Fourth Form: Striking Tide. Tanjiro begins generating an energy ball to direct towards the Demon Slayers, however, his attack is intercepted by Nezuko and severely damages her arm. A powerless Zenitsu cries out to Tanjiro, horrified at the thought of Nezuko dying by the hands of her brother. As Giyu and an onlooking Yushiro try to find a way to stop Tanjiro, Kanao Tsuyuri arrives, bringing a vial of the medicine that could restore his humanity. Kanao uses the Flower Breathing, Final Form: Equinoctial Vermilion Eye on her left eye and approaches Tanjiro to inject him with the medicine, getting struck by one of Tanjiro's bone appendages in the process. In Tanjiro's mind, Muzan tries to convince him to let himself be consumed by the desire of becoming the ultimate being. Tanjiro vehemently refuses Muzan's offer and several hands belonging to his loved ones, both deceased and alive, rise from the ground and through the wisteria flowers to push and reach out for him. Tanjiro accepts their grasps and is brought back to reality with his humanity restored. Muzan fades from Tanjiro's subconscious, finally defeated for good. Aftermath. Tanjiro later awakens surrounded by a tearful Nezuko and the rest of the Demon Slayer Corps, gleefully welcoming him back. Kanao is later shown to be alive despite her injuries and she manages to share a heartful smile to Tanjiro, which he reciprocates. On the other hand, Yushiro, who is currently hiding from the sun, manages to find Tamayo's hairpin. He tearfully comments that the long-lasting battle between the Demon Slayer Corps and Muzan has come to a close. Three months later, Kiriya announces that the Demon Slayer Corps will officially be disbanded and thanks the remaining active Hashira, Sanemi and Giyu, for their hard work. In turn, both Hashira thank the Ubuyashiki family for giving them the chance to avenge their loved ones, which greatly moves Kiriya. Meanwhile, Tanjiro is recovering in the Butterfly Estate, and comments that now Muzan's control over him is gone, his regenerated arm has heavily aged and lost its sensation from the elbow downwards while his regenerated eye is now blinded. However, Nezuko reassures him that this is for the best. After Tanjiro, Zenitsu and Inosuke are fully healed, they all move to Tanjiro's old house and live happily. At some point before its disbandment, the Demon Slayer Corps members and their relatives took a commemorative photo together. The photo, along with Yoriichi Tsugikuni's Hanafuda earrings and Tanjiro's Nichirin Blade with Kyojuro Rengoku's hilt still exist in the present day, under the care of the Kamado household.

Doma is a major supporting antagonist of "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba". He is a demon affiliated with the Twelve Kizuki, holding the second highest position, . Over a century ago, Doma held the position of, and during that tenure, he turned Gyutaro and Ume into demons and introduced them into the Twelve Kizuki. He is also the leader of the Eternal Paradise Faith, a cult dedicated to worshipping Doma and a place where he listens to all his followers' troubles and gives them advice. It also acts as a place for Doma to capture and kill humans. This cult also took in Inosuke Hashibira's mother, Kotoha Hashibira, before Doma killed her after finding out that he was eating his followers. Appearance. Doma is a tall young man with a lean but toned and muscular body, who is of extremely pale complexion and possessed unusually long, pointed nails that appeared to be stained with a pale blue color. He possesses long platinum blond hair that he wore parted to his right, the shorter parts around his face seeming to flare out to either side around his head, curving backwards with one lock slanting down to the right of his face to fall between his eyes, while the longer parts were left to drape centrally down his back in a thinning spiral. His eyes have been described to be incredibly rare and beautiful, as, in color, they appeared to be made up of an array of rainbow pastel tones that fade into one another as they circle his irises, this unusual appearance even causing people to believe Doma is a blessed being who could communicate with the gods. The kanji for and for (or and at the time when he first met Gyutaro and Daki) is etched across them, with thick eyelashes and a set of notably large, thick black eyebrows acting to frame them above. Doma wore a blood-red turtleneck of a design that made it appear that the section between his neck and upper chest is covered by a black substance that looks like it's dripping slightly down his body, this same design repeated at his wrists and down his hands, as well as on the small, circular "blood stain" he adorned on his head. Below this, he wore a pair of straight, tan-colored hakama pants of a pinstriped design, their cuffs visibly loose, which he secured with a pale green-tinged golden belt, its buckle a bright silver. He also only wears plain black on his feet. On occasion, Doma may also have been seen sporting a black cloak, which he drapes around his shoulders, two lengths of purple and black cloth with a rectangular pattern also hanging from it around his neck, as well as a which is lined with gold around its frontal plates and has flowing black ribbons dangling from each of its sides. He is also usually seen holding a pair of sharp fans that were made entirely out of shining gold, a lotus design engraved across them and a green tassel at the base, which acted as his primary weapons. Personality. Doma is outwardly friendly and cheery, possessing an approachable and charismatic air. Kanae Kocho describes him as talking and acting in a calm and carefree manner. However, it is soon revealed that Doma has psychopathic tendencies. He adopts sick beliefs and habits, such as devouring his cult's followers with the belief he is saving them from their suffering and pain. He believes he is saving them from their suffering by letting them live inside his body. Under his carefree and unassuming demeanor, Doma is a cold and calculating individual with an extremely keen intellect. His high intelligence may be the reason why he looks down on humans, genuinely believing that they are pathetic and pitiful. He even cried out of pity for them. His condescending attitude towards humans was also showcased when he was decapitated by the combined efforts of Shinobu Kocho, Inosuke Hashibira, and Kanao Tsuyuri. He felt insulted to be killed by individuals whom he thought lowly of. It is later revealed that Doma is clinically apathetic, completely emotionless, and unable to experience proper emotions. Doma himself admitted that the concept of emotion was completely foreign to him, even as a human. Aware that this is abnormal, Doma compensated for his empty heart with his own charisma. He learned to express his carefree demeanor enough to deceive all but the most keen observers.Despite his innate apathy, he appeared angry when Kanao insulted his inability to feel real emotions, dropping his kindly façade and outright trying to kill her. His apathy is shown when his mother murdered his father and then proceeded to kill herself all while being observed by Doma when he was a child; Doma didn't show any sign of grief or shock, but instead complained that their blood made the room stuffy. In spite of his apathy, Doma has a disturbing habit of primarily eating young women, as evident by most of his cult followers being women. One exception to this was Inosuke's mother, Kotoha Hashibira, who Doma didn't want to kill and instead wanted to keep by his side until she died of natural causes, though he eventually killed her when she tried to escape. The reason for this unique behaviorial trait is because women provide more nutritional value for demons as they can nurture babies, so therefore provide more strength and nutrients. During his interactions with fellow Upper Rank Akaza, he showed no negative reactions to him delivering two fatal blows to his head in annoyance, one with Akaza swiftly punching the upper part of Doma's head off, then punching his jaw off. In fact, he considered this to be their form of personal "greeting" between two "best friends." Doma has even implied that he actually enjoys these physical abuses as seen when he morbidly asked Muzan with excitement on what type of extreme self harm he should inflict on himself as punishment for his failure, and again expressed delight upon the severe pain he felt at Shinobu Kocho's numerous attempts to poison him to death and even cheerfully expresses his delight on the feelings and sensations of the poison destroying his body and how he might actually grow to "like" it. Despite leading a cult, Doma is a nihilistic atheist who staunchly believed that gods, Buddhas, and the afterlife do not exist. He believed that after death there is nothing and that people who "could not accept something so simple" are naïve and dumb. However, during his death, he began to question if Heaven and Hell could actually do exist. Doma also displayed what was arguably is his first true emotion when he proclaimed his love for Shinobu after finding her cute. Abilities. Overall Abilities. As the holder of the second highest ranking member of the Twelve Kizuki, and the third most powerful of his kind to have ever existed, Doma is an exceptionally powerful demon. His combination of combative prowess and his potent cryokinetic Blood Demon Art in battle is powerful enough to overwhelm and defeat the Insect Hashira, Shinobu Kocho, without any difficulty, and he is also noted to have defeated Kanae Kocho, the late Flower Hashira, in the past. Afterwards, Doma could take on both Inosuke and Kanao, who were on par with the Hashira, simultaneously without much effort either. According to Doma, Akaza, who holds the rank of Upper Three, would have no chance in defeating him in battle, to the point where even he wouldn't dare challenge Doma to a battle, despite the Upper Rank's immense outward hatred toward him. Moreover, Doma was able to surpass Akaza in a shorter period of time, showcasing the immense power gap between the two demons. As further credence to Doma's immense power, he rarely fights seriously and instead adopts a casual and carefree attitude even in life-and-death situations against the most powerful Demon Slayers, only ever becoming serious when his life is in serious danger, such as when the deadly effects of Shinobu's poisons became apparent. Apathy: Doma is diagnosed as clinically apathetic, unable to experience human emotions. Despite this, he maintains a friendly and carefree façade that deceives all but the most astute observers. Kanao is the only person who can see through his façade, thanks to her exceptional eyesight. She believes that Doma impersonates emotions in the hopes that he could eventually acquire the ability to feel them himself, a concept entirely foreign to him. Even in his childhood, Doma exhibited little to no emotion. When his mother killed his father before taking her own life in front of him, he remained unaffected by the traumatising event; his only reaction was annoyance over the blood that was making the room stuffy. This inability to feel emotions has become an advantage for Doma, as this allows him to calmly process, understand and analyze any situation he is faced with without being hampered by emotions, allowing him to easily and quickly come up with any solution for any adversary. Although, after his death, he seemed to have developed feelings for Shinobu Kocho, making it the first time he actually shows true emotion. Keen Intellect: Doma is exceptionally intelligent, which he displayed on multiple occasions. While in a fast-paced brawl with Kanao, he was able to process and deduce her abilities, surmising that it was her superhuman eyesight that allowed her to parry and dodge his ice attacks and immediately develop a strategy to counter it. In another instance, when he left Kanao and Inosuke to fight his ice clones, he construed that Inosuke had an acute sense of touch just by observing his behavior when near his ice techniques. It is also implied that Doma was able to trick and deceive all of his followers, allowing him to kill and eat them. He was able to keep this up for over a century with almost complete infallibility. Doma also possesses incredible memory, being able to remember even the most insignificant details from back when he was human, which was over a century ago. Demon Abilities. Biological Absorption: Doma briefly displayed the ability to absorb human bodies through physical contact, shown when he completely broke down and assimilated Shinobu's body within only a few seconds of killing her. He mostly uses this ability as a faster alternative of consuming humans during battle. Immense Regeneration: As an Upper Rank demon, Doma possesses one of the most advanced and powerful regenerative healing factors in existence. When Akaza punched off both his lower jaw and the upper portion of his head, he instantly healed with ease, even considering the fatal attack to be a friendly gesture. Doma also took mere seconds to recover from Shinobu's onslaught of fatal Wisteria poison attacks and from a deep slash in his abdomen which caused his guts to spill out. Even when Doma absorbed Shinobu's body and ingested over 37 kilograms worth of poison, approximately 700 times more than the lethal amount needed to kill an average demon, it still took a considerable amount of time before it began to have any adverse effect on him. Physical Abilities. Immense Durability: As an Upper Rank demon who has assimilated a huge amount of Muzan's blood, Doma has an exceptionally durable body. This is shown when Kanao had difficultly slicing Doma's neck even when his body was falling apart due to the extreme dosage of poison he received. Kanao only succeeded in decapitating the Upper Rank when Inosuke used his swords to push her blade through Doma's neck, and even then, his body was already decomposing due to the severe poisoning he endured from Shinobu. Immense Speed & Reflexes: Doma possesses inhuman movement speed and reflexes, being able to move so fast he appears to teleport. Being of a higher rank, he is faster than Akaza, who was able to keep up with a Marked Giyu, and Gyutaro who was able to keep up with and overpower Tengen, the fastest runner among the Taisho era Hashira. He first displayed his immense speed during the Upper Rank meeting, where he appeared to teleport to Gyokko, which caught him off guard. Later, when Akaza appeared behind him and destroyed his head, Doma claimed that he could've easily evaded it if he wanted to, but didn't do so on purpose as he wanted to get along with him. His imperceptible speed was further testified when he sliced a woman to pieces after Shinobu, the fastest Hashira Doma has met, brought her away from his attack range, even taking the Insect Hashira a moment to register the attack. Moreover, Doma was shown to be able to keep up with Shinobu's own tremendous speed for the majority of the fight. More impressively, Doma was able to deliver a deep cut to Shinobu before she could even react. Against Kanao, a Hashira-level Demon Slayer, Doma was able to easily dodge her Crimson Hanagoromo technique while still busy absorbing Shinobu, and later managed to move so fast he appeared to teleport behind her, nearly decapitating the Demon Slayer's head. Later on in the fight, Doma managed to completely blitz Kanao, running up to her from a considerably far distance, stealing her Nichirin katana while she was still gripping onto it, and returning to his original spot so fast that Kanao, despite possessing superhuman vision, couldn't react to, let alone perceive the Upper Rank's movements, even taking several seconds to comprehend and realize what just happened. Similarly, Doma blitzed Inosuke, this time, stealing his mask without he and Kanao realizing it until several seconds later. Due to how casual Doma was when he performed the aforementioned feats, it is implied that Doma could've instantly blitzed and killed both Kanao and Inosuke had he taken the fight more seriously. Unlimited Stamina & Endurance: Doma possesses absolute and infinite stamina and vitality, never tiring and always remaining in optimal physical and mental condition all the time as well as being able to endure waves of onslaught as if it were nothing. He showed almost complete immunity to being repeatedly violently attacked by his fellow Upper Rank, Akaza, having his eyes slashed out by Inosuke, being repeatedly poisoned and stabbed by Shinobu, having his stomach slashed open by Kanao, and inflicting various forms of extreme self-harm to himself. Doma never once expressed the slightest bit of pain, discomfort and panic at being wounded so grievously, having been able to nonchalantly and calmly continue fighting, talking or doing whatever else he is doing as if nothing is happening. Supernatural Abilities. Extrasensory Perception: Doma possesses extraordinary sensory abilities which allow him to detect things outside the normal range of perception, as shown when he could perceive attacks even from places he is not looking at, allowing him to nullify the effectiveness of sneak attacks. Later, Doma was capable of detecting Akaza's transformation into a demon immune to decapitation by Nichirin Swords despite being extremely far away from him. Fighting Style. Tessenjutsu: Doma is incredibly skilled in as shown during his battles against the Demon Slayers. It is implied that his skill in this martial arts surpasses Akaza's bare-fisted combat prowess due to his superior ranking compared to Akaza. Doma showcased his skill in dual wielding his Japanese war fans against Kanao and Inosuke, where he could easily fend off both combatants, displaying his ability in using his fans for both attacking and defending during high-speed battles, parrying and delivering attacks that overwhelmed the Demon Slayers. With his exceptional proficiency in Tessenjutsu, Doma could make use of techniques that require him to perform eight to nine fan attacks in the blink of an eye and generate huge gusts of air with them. Furthermore, Doma's Tessenjutsu incorporates his cryokinetic Blood Demon Art which enhances its range and lethality, making his fighting style a great blend of offense and defense. Blood Demon Art. Cryokinesis: Doma's Blood Demon Art grants him extremely powerful cryokinesis. He can generate ice and frost from his flesh and blood and can spawn it anywhere in his vicinity, as well as manipulating it at will, allowing him to unleash incredibly potent ice techniques. Additionally, the ice created from his Blood Demon Art is extremely lethal to those that inhale it, causing the cells of the victim's lungs to die and rendering them unable to breathe very quickly. His ice and frost has also been noted to be extremely cold, as shown when the air around Doma's frost was cold enough to make Shinobu's lungs feel as if they were about to burst and nearly freeze Kanao's body and surroundings just by coming into contact with it. Doma is incredibly proficient in his Blood Demon Art, being capable of creating constructs out of the ice he generates such as frost lotuses, stalagmites, clouds of icy air and even miniature ice clones of himself capable of unleashing the same techniques as him. He has also shown the ability to use the ice he creates as extra appendages, as seen when he created ice vines to hold himself up the ceiling while he uses his arms to hug Shinobu. In combat, Doma usually incorporates his cryokinetic abilities with his Tessenjutsu, enhancing his fan attacks with ice and frost. Doma prefers to use his Blood Demon Art to create frost lotuses and crystal-like shards made of ice. Techniques. <tabber> </tabber> Equipment. Japanese War Fans: Doma carries around a pair of gold-plated most likely fashioned from his flesh (similar to all other weapons used by demons), that act as his main offensive weapons and aid in spreading his Blood Demon Art. His fans are of a golden color with several patterns resembling lotuses engraved on the side complete with a green tassel. They are extremely sharp and suited for his style of combat, being able to slice and slash as well as swords and generate huge gusts of air. They are also shown to be extremely durable, withstanding multiple sword slashes and attacks without breaking.
