Urami =  is identical in appearance to Hantengu, with the exception of his larger size, towering over Tanjiro and Genya, and has the kanji for "resentment" etched into his tongue. Unlike Hantengu, he also wears an exasperated and furious expression on his face instead of an expression full of terror and fear. Urami seems to possess a much more muscular physique than Hantengu and noticeably has veins popping out all throughout his body. In addition, he seems to be the only emotion clone to lack any sort of pupils. </tabber> Personality. <tabber> Hantengu = Hantengu's primary form has a persona of extreme cowardice and agitation. He was easily frightened by what occurred in his surroundings, showing traits of paranoia, fear and delusion. He was always shown to cry out in fear at even the most insignificant things, such as the number of years since the last meeting of the Upper Ranks being 113. Moreover, during said meeting, Hantengu spent most of the situation crying out and cowering in fear over everything around him. This extreme paranoia is especially evident in the fact that when in his regular form, he always chooses to crawl instead of walking up straight. Even in combat, Hantengu was shown to be extremely cowardly and afraid, crying when he was slashed by Muichiro Tokito and when he was hiding from the Demon Slayers throughout most of the battle, trying to calm himself by hoping that his clones would kill them off. Hantengu seems to believe that he was completely innocent despite the obvious evidence pointing toward his numerous crimes as a human. He had a habit of deflecting the blame towards anything but himself, even proclaiming at one point that his hands were guilty but not himself as a whole. Even as a demon, killing and eating scores of innocent people, he stubbornly and erroneously maintained that he was innocent, and claimed that he deserved the sympathy of others. Sekido = As the manifestation of Hantengu's anger, Sekido was in a constant state of vexation, irritation, and rage, even towards his fellow clones, which could be seen when he easily got angered when they failed to meet his expectations and were subdued by the Demon Slayers. Sekido was also seen to care very little about his brethren, as shown when he forcibly absorbed them against their will to form Zohakuten, even as Aizetsu protested. He also showed himself to be the most dominant of the emotion clones and seemed to be the leader, as he was the one who gave out orders to them and took charge at critical junctures when they were battling the Demon Slayers. Despite his irate demeanor, he is not above feeling sadistic glee when he has his enemies backed to a corner, as he showed a smile of satisfaction in seeing Tanjiro and Nezuko forced on the defensive. Karaku = As the manifestation of Hantengu's pleasure, Karaku showcased himself to be the most relaxed and laid-back of Hantengu's clones. The entire time he was battling against Genya, Tanjiro and Nezuko, he was constantly praising them and, instead of taking the battle seriously, he saw it as nothing more than a game, seeming to only take interest in the new experiences he was obtaining in the battle. This was demonstrated during his battle with Nezuko, when, instead of finishing her off immediately, he decided to tease and play with her despite being able to easily overpower her anytime he wanted. He also seems to display slight masochistic tendencies, which could be seen when he happily expressed his interest in the new sensation of having his neck being severed by a gunshot from Genya, commenting that he had never been injured like that before. This behavior easily got on the nerves of his fellow clones, such as Sekido, who constantly berated him for not taking on a serious outlook in battle, and Aizetsu, who was confused at why he was taking so long to kill Nezuko. Aizetsu = As the manifestation of Hantengu's sorrow, Aizetsu was portrayed to be completely dejected, sour, and negative, constantly describing everything as depressing. Out of all the manifestations, Aizetsu was shown to be the calmest and most collected out of all five of them, as seen when instead of frivolously wasting time on entertainment as Urogi and Karaku or immediately getting agitated and enraged by anything like Sekido, Aizetsu was shown to calmly analyze his opponents and think out his strategy and figure out his opponents' abilities and weaknesses before attacking. Unlike the usually vicious and bloodthirsty attitude most demons possess when killing humans, or even compared to the rest of Hantengu's clones, Aizetsu chooses to kill quickly by striking vital areas. His perpetual dour and sadness even extends towards his fellow clones, as seen when he complies with Sekido's orders only make him stop yelling. Urogi = As the manifestation of Hantengu's joy, Urogi is the most jovial and giddy of Hantengu's clones. Similar to Karaku, he seemed to view the entire battle against the Demon Slayers as nothing more than a game or as a source of entertainment, as seen when he happily complemented Tanjiro on his intelligence for correctly guessing that neither one of the four clones was the "real" body and constantly exclaimed that the entire fight against Tanjiro was delightful. Zohakuten = As the manifestation of Hantengu's hatred, Zohakuten shared many personality traits with Sekido, as he too was easily enraged and was incredibly spiteful and hateful towards his enemies, due to him deeming them as "evil" for bullying the "weak and innocent" Hantengu. Like Sekido, he was also foul-mouthed as seen when he constantly insulted his opponents and referred to Mitsuri as a harlot, constantly calling her various degrading names in his thoughts. He also seemed to harbor an immense sense of loyalty towards Muzan Kibutsuji, as seen when he told Mitsuri that he only heeds and follows the orders of one man in the entire world. Out of all the clones, he was shown to be the most intelligent and insightful, aside from Sekido, as seen when he easily analyzed why the Love Hashira survived his powerful attacks and figured out the true source of her strength. Moreover, he was not above admitting to his own weakness, as he determined that the best way to kill Mitsuri was to exhaust her endurance and strength through incessant attacks upon seeing that she was capable of evading and attacking his Blood Demon Arts successfully. Urami = As the manifestation of Hantengu's resentment, Urami was shown to be just as hypocritical and delusional as Zohakuten and Hantengu, as he angrily told Tanjiro not to bully and hurt his "weak and innocent" self. He angrily asked why Tanjiro couldn't "see" his innocence and, true to his name, he has shown to be the embodiment of Hantengu's resentment due to him being punished and persecuted for crimes that he was "innocent" of. In addition, he is much more aggressive and quick to anger than his smaller counterpart, as he actively tries to seek out humans to replenish his regeneration and yelled at them when they tried to escape, and became enraged when Tanjiro vowed to decapitate him. </tabber> Abilities. Overall Abilities. As the holder of the fourth highest title in the Twelve Kizuki, Hantengu was an extremely powerful demon. Through his Blood Demon Art, he is able to create four clones that were manifestations of his emotions, each of them possessing an Upper Rank demon's level of strength and having their own unique power, allowing him to outnumber and overwhelm the Demon Slayers that tried to slay him and giving him a wide arsenal. Most notoriously about Hantengu's unique power is that he takes advantage of the traditional method of decapitation to kill a demon, as beheading Hantengu's primary form will cause Sekido and Karaku to emerge and engage the threat. Beheading the first two manifestations further will then result in the release of Aizetsu and Urogi, and any subsequent decapitations of the clones will prove futile if Hantengu remains alive, or in Urogi's case, severed body parts can even use his Blood Demon Art to attack an opponent. They were able to hold off and overwhelm the combined efforts of Tanjiro, Nezuko and Genya, all of whom were powerful and seasoned Demon Slayers. Genya stated that Hantengu was particularly difficult to defeat as the Demon Slayers would have to play a cat-and-mouse game instead of a traditional confrontation, hunting the main body while being hunted themselves by four Upper Rank-level demons. As another testament to their strength, when the four clones fused into one body, Zohakuten, he was once again capable of fending off all three Demon Slayers as well as the Love Hashira, Mitsuri Kanroji, one of the strongest Demon Slayers in the Demon Slayer Corps singlehandedly. Even after the Love Hashira awakened her Demon Slayer Mark and gained a considerable boost in speed and strength, she could only evade and dodge Zohakuten's attacks and stall him until the Demon Slayers defeated the main body, Hantengu. As Zohakuten and Tanjiro had stated, Mitsuri would've run out of stamina and died if not for the sun rising and Hantengu being killed. This nearly came to fruition as Mitsuri eventually did became too exhausted to continue fighting and was only saved when Zohakuten was burned to ash from Hantengu's death. <tabber> Hantengu = Demon Abilities. Size Alteration: Hantengu has the ability to change his size at will, as shown when he shrunk himself to a small enough size to fit into a wooden burl during most of Zohakuten's battle with the Demon Slayers, allowing him to stay hidden until the Demon Slayers began to actively seek him out. Physical Abilities. Immense Durability: Hantengu possesses a body so durable that not even Genya's Nichirin steel shot could leave a dent on his body, the same bullets which tore of the necks of his clones with relative ease. Even when Genya tried to cut off Hantengu's body with his Nichirin Sword, his blade broke before it could do any damage. Even with the use of his bright red blade, Tanjiro was initially unable to make a dent in his neck. Immense Speed & Reflexes: As an Upper Rank demon, Hantengu possesses incredible movement speed and reflexes, being able to evade both Muichiro's Mist Breathing technique and Tanjiro's Hinokami Kagura's technique with little effort. When he was in his smallest form, he could run fast enough that Tanjiro, Nezuko, or Genya, then enhanced with the flesh of an Upper Rank, could not keep up. Supernatural Abilities. Enhanced Stealth: Due to his ability to shrink in size, Hantengu possesses immense skill in stealth, which can be seen when he managed to easily infiltrate the Swordsmith Village, one of the Demon Slayer Corps' most vital and well fortified bases, without any of the numerous Demon Slayers stationed there noticing. Hantengu later managed to sneak into Muichiro's and Tanjiro's room without any of them detecting him, despite the former possessing a heightened ability to sense the presence of demons and the latter possessing an incredibly acute sense of smell that would've sensed a demon's presences from extremely long distances. His stealth also enabled him to trick both Muichiro and Tanjiro into a false sense of security, as it was not until he got close to attack them that they realized Hantengu was truly an Upper Rank. Sekido = Demon Abilities. Biological Absorption: Sekido displayed the ability to draw in and absorb the bodies of Karaku, Urogi, and Aizetsu, fusing to become Zohakuten. Flesh Manipulation: Like all demons, Sekido possesses the ability to control and alter his flesh to a certain extent. Sekido uses this ability to shape his flesh into a which he uses as a means to channel his Blood Demon Art. He is shown to be capable of creating more than one at a time. Physical Abilities. Immense Speed & Reflexes: As an Upper Rank demon, Sekido possesses incredible speed and reflexes comparable to that of the Hashira. This was shown when he was fast enough to block the bullets from Genya's shotgun before they could reach him. He is also seen being able to absorb Karaku, Urogi, and Aizetsu in the mere blink of an eye to transform into Zohakuten, a feat only witnessed by the perception of the demon-enhanced Genya. Karaku = Demon Abilities. Flesh Manipulation: Like all demons, Karaku possesses the ability to control and alter his flesh to a certain extent. Karaku uses this ability to shape his flesh into a maple leaf-shaped . Similar to Sekido, Karaku can create more than one Uchiwa at a time, even creating an enlarged version of it to increase its area of effect. Physical Abilities. Immense Strength: Karaku displayed incredible physical strength as he was able to nonchalantly overpower Nezuko, pierce her durable body with a single kick, and ripped her hand off with ease. Unlimited Stamina & Endurance: Like all demons, Karaku possesses infinite stamina and endurance. When Genya shot off his head with his shotgun, leaving his head dangling on a piece of flesh and having his neck bones exposed, Karaku never showed any signs of pain but rather exclaimed in excitement over how he has never felt an attack like that and proclaimed that it was fun. Aizetsu = Demon Abilities. Flesh Manipulation: Like all demons, Aizetsu possesses the ability to control and alter his flesh to a certain extent. Aizetsu uses this ability to shape his flesh into a . Physical Abilities. Unlimited Stamina & Endurance: Like all demons, Aizetsu possesses infinite stamina and endurance. This was shown when he was able to engage in battle with Genya for an extended period of time without showing any signs of fatigue in the slightest. Aizetsu was also completely nonchalant when Genya destroyed his neck with a shotgun that fired Nichirin steel shot, even managing to attack without his head intact and heal his neck with ease. Urogi = Demon Abilities. Avian Physiology: Urogi's unique body allows him to gain the attributes and abilities of avian creatures, namely his large feathered wings and razor sharp talons. These large wings grant Urogi the ability to fly at incredibly high speeds while his talons are powerful enough to cut through diamond. He frequently fights in the same manner as how a bird of prey hunts, swooping down to a target to attack with his talons. A drawback to this ability is that his body has to be extremely light for him to fly, which gave an opportunity for Tanjiro to use Urogi's own flight against him. Zohakuten = Demon Abilities. Flesh Manipulation: Like all demons, Zohakuten possesses the ability to control and alter his flesh to a certain extent. He primarily uses this ability to form the drums attached to his back to form his Blood Demon Arts and the bone-like daggers to beat said drums to control it. Supernatural Abilities. Menacing Aura: Zohakuten possesses an extremely menacing and overwhelming presence. Tanjiro choked on his breath and felt immense pain in his heart from Zohakuten's mere gaze. His aura is so strong that Genya could barely stand and caused him to start sweating profusely. Urami = Demon Abilities. Size Alteration: As Hantengu's last ditch attempt to escape from the Demon Slayers, Urami has the ability to greatly increase his size in order for Hantengu to hide in his heart. Physical Abilities. Immense Durability: As Upper Rank Four's largest manifestation, Urami proved to be incredibly durable. He was able to shrug off the effects of Nezuko's fires with little trouble and has the notable feat of being able to endure the effects of direct sunlight for an extended amount of time, due to Hantengu still being alive and hidden inside him. Tanjiro noted that though his death in sunlight was inevitable, it would have taken enough time to cost the lives of the swordsmiths he is pursuing and forced him to take immediate action. Immense Strength: Due to his large size and muscular physique, Urami is immensely strong and hard to take on in a physical fight. He uses this in an attempt to strangle Tanjiro, with a demon-enhanced Genya struggling to pry Urami's hands off. Urami proved so physically potent, Nezuko was forced to use her Blood Demon Art in order to simply weaken him to the point they could continue attacking. </tabber> Fighting Style. Blood Demon Art. <tabber> Hantengu = Emotion Manifestation: Hantengu's Blood Demon Art allows him to manifest his emotions as younger clones of himself. Each clone personifies a core emotion, which can be identified by a kanji on their tongue. These clones all have different appearances, abilities, and weapons, with their individual strength being at least Upper Rank caliber, and all of them seemingly resembling a younger Hantengu. The emotions shown are anger, pleasure, sorrow, joy, hatred, and resentment, with Hantengu himself having the kanji of "fear" etched onto his tongue. It is implied that Hantengu can control these clones however he sees fit, as seen when he took control of Urami's body to kill a group of swordsmiths after he was beheaded. This Blood Demon Art is activated when Hantengu's head is cut off, where his head and body turn into two separate clones, one that personifies his anger, and the other which personifies his pleasure. After these two clones are decapitated, they split off into two more clones, personifying his sorrow and joy. One notable trait about these manifestations is they cannot be killed when Hantengu himself is still alive. Damaging the clones' tongues has shown to slow their regeneration speed momentarily. If need be, Sekido, the personification of Hantengu's anger, can absorb the 3 other clones present to form a younger, even stronger clone, Zohakuten, who is able to use all of the 4 clone's Blood Demon Arts along with his own. Sekido = Electricity Generation: Sekido's Blood Demon Art allows him to generate electricity that flashes blue and red from his Khakkhara by stabbing it onto a surface, typically the ground. His electricity is extremely potent, instantly paralyzing targets, even if they are in mid-air, and causing them to lose consciousness in a short period of time. His Blood Demon Art has a wide area of effect, allowing him to subdue multiple targets at once. He can also summon electricity in the form of lightning that strikes his targets from above. One drawback to his electricity is that it cannot pass through anything made from his own cells, such as the body parts of any of Hantengu's clones, which Tanjiro utilized to avoid getting shocked. Karaku = Wind Blasts: Karaku's Blood Demon Art allows him to generate powerful gusts of wind using his maple leaf-shaped Uchiwa. By simply swinging his Uchiwa down, Karaku can generate a gust of wind strong enough to blow Muichiro into a distant forest in an instant, leave gigantic craters, level an entire building, and crush Demon Slayer and demon alike under its immense pressure, even knocking them unconscious. Karaku is capable of using his Blood Demon Art tactically, hitting the entire battlefield with gusts of strong wind in order to make it harder for his opponents to move akin to being in a tornado. However, this ability is not limited to him; anyone who has possession of his Uchiwa can create his powerful winds, as shown when Nezuko used Karaku's own Uchiwa to blow him away. Aizetsu = Spear Projection: Aizetsu's Blood Demon Art allows him to project the thrusting attack of his Yari over great distances, allowing him to attack his targets from afar. Additionally, its potency has been shown to be enhanced, as Genya, in his attempt to shield Tanjiro, was left with numerous puncture wounds all over his body. Urogi = Sonic Scream: Urogi's Blood Demon Art allows him to generate powerful sound waves from his mouth. The power from Urogi's scream is strong enough to make Tanjiro bleed from his nose and ear, momentarily stunning him. He can even utilize it while not whole, as shown when his leg was severed but still attached to Tanjiro, enabling him to manipulate his flesh into a mouth to use the scream again. However, the strength of his attack appears to be at a specific level, as Tanjiro noticed that the scream of his leg's mouth was not as potent as before. Zohakuten = Wood Manipulation: Zohakuten's main Blood Demon Art grants him the ability to generate wood out of his flesh and blood and manipulate it by striking the drums at his back. Zohakuten mainly shapes the wood into massive snake-like dragon heads that can stretch up to twenty meters in length, though he can also create dragon heads within the main dragon heads in order to increase its length and reach. Using, Zohakuten can create a lot more wooden dragons to attack his targets. The dragons attack by biting them with their massive jaws or trapping them inside its mouth to be crushed. The wood he creates is extremely durable, being impervious to sword slashes from a demon-enhanced Genya Shinazugawa. Zohakuten's dragons have incredible maneuverability, and their numbers make them even more deadly to deal with. As these wooden dragons are made from his flesh and blood, they can regenerate quickly if they are damaged. Other than his wooden dragons, Zohakuten also displayed the ability to shape wood into a twisted trunk-like burl which he uses to protect and hide Hantengu's main body. Like his dragons, Zohakuten can move this burl at will to conceal it or to attack those that get too close to it. This trunk can also create branch to act as whips to deter targets. Ability Combination: Zohakuten and his wooden dragons can use the Blood Demon Arts of Sekido, Karaku, Aizetsu, and Urogi. Moreover, Zohakuten can use them at a much higher level than the four clones. Zohakuten and his wooden dragons can emit electricity in the form of lightning bolts, unleash powerful wind blasts that leave craters in the ground, project spear-like attacks out of thin air, and generate deafening sound waves that can momentarily knock out Mitsuri Kanroji, a Hashira. Urami = Ability Combination: It is heavily implied that Urami is able to utilize the other clone's Blood Demon Arts as seen when he utilized Urogi's powerful sound waves to stun Tanjiro and Genya. </tabber> Techniques. <tabber> </tabber> Equipment. <tabber> Sekido = Khakkhara: Sekido wields a fashioned from his flesh. It serves as his main tool in combat when used in conjunction with his Blood Demon Art, allowing him to channel his lightning and strike at close and wide ranges to shock, paralyze, and incapacitate his targets. When fighting in close combat, Sekido can also use his Khakkhara as a melee weapon, which he does when Nezuko arms herself with Karaku's Uchiwa. Sekido has also been shown to create multiple Khakkharas at the same time, as he formed a new one in his hand to attack Tanjiro whilst his previous one was still imbedded in Nezuko's neck. Gallery. Karaku = Uchiwa: Karaku wields a maple leaf-shaped fashioned from his flesh. It serves as his main tool in combat when used in conjunction with his Blood Demon Art, allowing him to generate powerful gusts of wind to launch his enemies a far distance and to level any battlefield and turn it into one full of torrents of wind, making it extremely difficult for his opponents to fight or even move. However, this Uchiwa can be used by anyone, which makes Karaku susceptible to having his wind Blood Demon Art used against him by his opponents. Gallery. Aizetsu = Jūmonji Yari: Aizetsu wields a fashioned from his flesh. He also occasionally uses the blunt end of the weapon in order to stun enemies. Hantengu/Relationships Relationships. Muzan Kibutsuji. Hantengu like all members of the Twelve Kizuki is shown to be faithfully loyal to Muzan and following each and everyone of his orders and demands without question despite Muzan's usual demeaning and condescending attitude towards him. However despite this Hantengu is shown to be truly loyal to him in the deepest part of his heart due to his loyalty even extending to his five Emotion Clones, as seen where Zohakuten stated during his battle against Mitsuri Kanroji that only "one person can give orders to me in this world" and Sekido, Urogi, Karaku and Aizetsu all agree he is someone they are loyal to and show the utmost respect to despite their vastly different personalities and volatile relationship. The source of this deep respect and loyalty being the fact that Muzan, in Hantengu's perspective, is the first person to "believe" in his innocence, due to him having saved Hantengu from being "falsely" executed by a "corrupt" magistrate by giving him the power to escape his imprisonment by turning him into a Demon. This loyalty was shown to be strong enough that, before dying Hantengu's last act was to report to Muzan about how Nezuko Kamado had successfully become the first Demon to conquer the sun. Muzan in turn was shown to have become incredibly pleased and happy with Hantengu due to him having successfully located a Demon capable of becoming immune to sunlight, causing the Demon Lord to explode in ecstatic joy at this discovery and even compliment Hantengu for his good work, a rarity due to Muzan's typical arrogant behavior towards the Upper Ranks and his mentality of deeming them all expendable. Twelve Kizuki. Hantengu is the holder of the position of Upper Rank 4 of the Twelve Kizuki and as such is shown to have a positive enough relationship with the rest of the Upper Ranks to effectively work together when they are given tasks and assignments by Muzan. However due to Hantengu's overly fearful and submissive personality, it is shown that during his typical meetings with his fellow Upper Ranks, Hantengu acts very frightened and shy around his fellow demons, as seen during their meeting where he preferred to hide around the stairs and corners of Infinity Castle than directly speak to any of them unless needed. Gyokko. Hantengu and Gyokko are shown to have a positive enough relationship with each other that they can easily work together in missions without much difficulty. Muzan is seen to trust the two of them enough to successfully accomplish a high risk mission such as wiping out the Swordsmith Village of the Demon Slayer Corps successfully. Akaza. Hantengu due to his easily frightened personality, is seen to not particularly like his superior Upper Rank 3 due to Akaza's own violent and confrontational personality, as seen where he was easily frightened by him and bowed his head in submissiveness whenever he raised his voice during his arguments with Upper Ranks 2 & 1 during the meeting. Emotion Clones. Each of Hantengu's Emotion Clones are shown to have varied relationships with each other due to each of them having a distinct personality. Despite this however, they are shown to get along enough to cooperate during a battle and all are shown to greatly prioritize Hantengu in battle and protect him from all threats due to him being their "core".

Hantengu/Synopsis History. Human Life. Even as a child, Hantengu was a frequent liar who deflected blame towards him onto anyone else. Whenever something happened, he would play the part of the victim and did anything he could in order to make others around him look bad as a way to gain sympathy. Throughout most of his adult life, Hantengu committed many heinous crimes. He stole from numerous innocent people and murdered others in various towns and cities, all the while claiming that he was innocent, even once claiming that his hands alone were solely to blame for his actions, thus hinting that he was also mentally unstable and delusional due to his claims. He was even married several times and had children, but falsely believed he was being mistreated and killed his many wives and children in "retaliation". Eventually, he was captured by a high-ranked magistrate and sentenced to death by decapitation, despite his outrageous claims of innocence that were then silenced by threatening to cut off his "sinful" hands instead. One of the lies he told was that he could not have committed his crimes because he was blind, but the magistrate realized the truth when he looked at him before he spoke to him. While imprisoned and awaiting his execution, he was approached by Muzan Kibutsuji who offered to "help" him after taking pity on his situation and “believed” in his innocence. Muzan proceeded to give him some of his blood, transforming him into a demon. Demon Life. After his transformation, he escaped his prison and killed the magistrate who condemned him to his death sentence. With his dying breath, the magistrate told him that killing him didn't matter because eventually his past sins and actions will see him punished in the future no matter what he did. Over the course of the next 200 years, Hantengu would develop a unique and extremely powerful Blood Demon Art. All of the powerful emotions he felt throughout his life would manifest themselves into younger clones of himself, all equipped with unique powers and personalities. In time, he would eventually attain the position of Upper Rank Four of the Twelve Kizuki. Synopsis. Swordsmith Village Arc. Having been summoned to the Upper Ranks Meeting, Hantengu corrected Upper Rank Five Gyokko over the number of years since they had last met: one hundred and thirteen, a number which unnerved Hantengu. As Upper Three Akaza struck Upper Two Doma in annoyance, destroying the latter's jaw, Hantengu yelped in fear at the violence and cowered behind a staircase. He later bowed timidly as Muzan arrived and listened as his leader revealed the death of Gyutaro, before berating the Upper Ranks present for their uselessness in meeting his goals, causing Hantengu to beg him for forgiveness. Eventually, Gyokko provided Muzan with new information and was sent on a joint mission based on it with Hantengu. Upper Four quickly acknowledges Muzan's orders for him and Gyokko to head to an unknown location once the latter confirmed his newfound lead. Later, Akaza viciously destroyed the upper portion of Doma's head after he attempts to join their mission without Muzan's orders, only for the former to get his hand lopped off by Upper Rank One, Kokushibo, causing Hantengu to cower in fear and apprehension once again. Afterwards, he and Gyokko were then transported to their destination by the Biwa Demon. At the Swordsmith Village, Hantengu crawled on the roof of a building, eager to fulfill their mission to avoid facing Muzan's wrath. Crawling and sobbing inside one of the buildings, he encountered the Demon Slayer Tanjiro Kamado and the Mist Hashira Muichiro Tokito, shortly thereafter which, he was attacked. He swiftly avoids an attack from the latter by leaping to the ceiling and then dodged a follow-up attack from Tanjiro, only to be kicked by his demon sister Nezuko. His head was then severed by another slash from Muichiro, causing him to manifest two of his emotions: his anger Sekido and his pleasure Karaku. As Muichiro and Tanjiro attempted to attack the new demons, Karaku blew Muichiro far into the distance with a single wave of his . The two then confronted Tanjiro and Nezuko, briefly exchanging biting comments at each other, with Sekido then attacking Tanjiro with a burst of electricity from his . The two failed to notice Genya approaching them from behind with a shotgun. Firing both shells, Genya succeeds in decapitating Sekido but failing to completely sever Karaku's neck, much to the latter's amusement. The young Demon Slayer finished the job with his wakizashi, only for the anger and pleasure manifestations to split once more. Urogi, the winged manifestation of Hantengu's joy, then grabbed Tanjiro by the leg and flew off with him, while the manifestation of his sorrow, Aizetsu, impaled Genya with a . The former congratulated Tanjiro on figuring out their strategy, while the latter commented on Genya's pitiful weakness. Tanjiro urged Nezuko to help Genya, prompting his abductor to reprimand him for forgoing his own safety, before firing a concussive blast of sound waves at the Demon Slayer. Urogi grows surprised to find that his opponent had hacked off the leg holding him, a head then growing from the severed limb to fire the sound blast at a shocked Tanjiro. The disembodied leg of Urogi was then cut in two by Tanjiro, swiftly turning into two mouths that fired their sound waves at him once more. However, their attack power had been lessened due to consecutive divisions, leading Tanjiro to cut them once more and stop the attack. Urogi himself then appeared behind the Demon Slayer, firing another sound blast, which was dodged, but followed up by a vicious claw attack to Tanjiro's chest. Urogi then boasted about the sharpness of his claws, promising to carve up the young Demon Slayer, only to discover the youth had sliced his face in two. As Tanjiro prepared a follow-up attack, Urogi then attempted to fire the sound blast once more, only to have his jaw sliced off, causing him to land on the ground. Nonetheless, he quickly heals his wound and takes flight. Elsewhere, Karaku held back a transformed Nezuko, taunting her while Sekido told him to finish her off. Listening to the demon of anger's orders, Aizetsu offered to finish her off, only to discover he is unable to pull his weapon out of Genya, who promptly fired a point-blank blast at his head, partially decapitating him. Sekido reprimanded Aizetsu for this, leading the yari-wielding demon to then pull his weapon out and slashed Genya across the chest. Regenerating his head, Aizetsu grows annoyed at his opponent for not dying immediately, before he then noticed that Genya had begun to pray. Sekido commanded Aizetsu to crush the Demon Slayer's head, which resulted in the yari being swung at Genya's head. The weapon hit nothing but the floor as the Upper Rank's opponent appears behind him, swinging his sword at Aizetsu's head. This ambush was foiled by a burst of electricity from Sekido, who was shot at by their highly resilient opponent and has his right hand severed by his pellets, much to his frustration. Aizetsu then swung his yari, smashing into Genya's torso and driving him through a wall. Karaku commented that his allies were having fun, and told Nezuko that he was done with her, driving a foot through her chest. Karaku then told Sekido to stab and electrocute her until she didn't move anymore, ripping off one of Nezuko's hands off after his speech, leading Sekido to angrily note that it was his intentions to begin with. The young demon then responded with a sudden counterattack, nearly decapitating Karaku with a swift kick and splashing him with her blood. After burning him with her Blood Demon Art, she then torn the hand that held his uchiwa fan and the leg in her chest off. As Sekido demanded to know what Karaku was doing, Nezuko waved the torn arm and fan towards the latter, blowing him into the distance with his own wind. She attempted to do the same to Sekido, who foiled her attempt by stabbing her in the neck with the blunt end of his staff and electrocuting her. Elsewhere, Urogi continued to battle Tanjiro, managing to land a blow while avoiding one from his opponent, and circled around for another attempt. Aizetsu continued to confront Genya, who once again was praying, confused as to how he was still alive and wondering what he was. The Demon Slayer introduced himself and demanded he remember the name of the man who will kill him. As Urogi swooped in for his next attack, he is stabbed through the mouth by Tanjiro, causing the two of them to crash into the building they started in. Sekido, still in the process of electrocuting Nezuko, demanded to know what Karaku and Urogi were doing, and quickly grew a khakkhara out of his palm. He thrust the weapon at Tanjiro, who blocked it with Urogi's foot. Sekido praised Tanjiro's instincts, as his electricity cannot be transferred through his own cells, while the Demon Slayer slashes his tongue cut in half as he reaches Nezuko, slowing his regeneration. As his opponent freed his sister from his other khakkhara, Sekido tried to stab him in the neck behind, pinning him to the ground, but his attack was stopped from doing any further damage by Nezuko, who lit Sekido on fire with her Blood Demon Art. Just then, Karaku reappeared and leapt high above the building, using his fan to demolish part of the building his foes were fighting in, incapacitating both of them. He, Sekido, and Urogi then prepared to finish the pair. Their would-be victims recovered quickly and tried to flee, but were knocked down again by an electricity blast from Sekido. Urogi swooped in to attack them, but his attempt was dodged. As the two ran away, Sekido reprimanded Karaku for his slowness, telling him to level the whole building, which the demon of pleasure quickly accomplished. He then noted that the two no longer had any place to hide.  Eventually, the three manifestations found Tanjiro standing alone before them, amused to see him challenge all three of them at once. Even after noticing the Demon Slayer was wielding a new blade, Urogi was unfazed and charged in to attack the swordsman as Sekido and Karaku watched. However, it is only Sekido who realized that Tanjiro's burning blade was similar to that of the swordsman's from Muzan's memories, so much so that their very visages seemed to be overlapping. Tanjiro then unleashed Hinokami Kagura: Sun Halo Dragon Head Dance, decapitating all three in one powerful, fluid motion. A short distance away, Genya had managed to heavily injure Aizetsu, pinning him to a tree with his own yari and ripping his head off. Each of the demons hit by Tanjiro's attack reacted differently: Urogi simply screaming in pain, Karaku panicking over his apparent lack of regeneration, and Sekido berating the latter, stating they were still regenerating, but at a much slower pace. Sekido was the first to recover, firing his electricity blast at Tanjiro, Nezuko, and Genya, who were in the process of finding Hantengu's fifth body. Elsewhere, this fifth entity cowered, confident that the other emotion Demons would beat all the "bad guys". Tanjiro directed Genya towards the location of the fifth Hantengu, with Nezuko and himself providing cover for their scarred ally, with an immediate attack launched by Karaku, forcing the youth to grip a nearby tree while Sekido prepared to attack once more. He was attacked by Nezuko, who was immediately pierced by a recovered Aizetsu, who Sekido also attempted to attack, only to have his khakkhara hand severed by Tanjiro. Sekido realized that the youth was improving in ability as the battle progressed, just as he had been told and had observed thus far, noting he experienced explosive growth in critical situations. Urogi's right wing was subsequently severed by Tanjiro, and Aizetsu was grabbed by Nezuko's using both her hands and feet and lit on fire. Seeing this, Sekido desperately looked to see what Karaku was up to. Urogi used his uchiwa fan to crush Tanjiro into the ground, turning to attack one of the others, only for his fan arm and fan to be split in two by the youth's fiery counterattack. Furious, he stomped on the youth, who continued to give Genya directions on how to find the Upper Rank's fifth body. The two were ultimately successful, the fifth Hantengu cowering at the sight of Genya. The scarred youth shot at the tiny emotion Demon, to no effect, but the miniature Hantengu ran from him regardless. He was pursued by Genya, who swung his blade at the Fear Demon's neck, only for it to break. Another gunshot yielded a similar result, with Sekido attacking Genya from behind almost immediately afterward. Just as Sekido was about to land the fatal blow, his arm was severed by Tanjiro, causing him to land only a minor blow. As Sekido reeled from the attack, Aizetsu attempted to attack Tanjiro from behind with a flurry of air slashes. His attack was foiled by Genya, who took the brunt of the attack, allowing Tanjiro to land a blow with his fiery blade on the miniature Hantengu, who screamed in agony. As the Fear Demon continued to shriek, a sixth Hantengu appeared from behind Tanjiro, who continued to press his attack. However, the boost he had gotten from Nezuko's blood had ran out, the blade being halted by the miniature-Hantengu's thick neck. Genya shot at the sixth Hantengu, who struck at one of the drums on his body, summoning an amalgamation of tree and dragon, which attacked Tanjiro and flung him up into the sky. Mitsuri arrived and caught Tanjiro, gently allowing him to rest while she fought the new clone who has the word "hatred" inscribed on his drums. The hatred clone, named Zohakuten, wrapped his miniature copy in a protective covering of branches. This new form was revealed to be the result of Sekido absorbing Karaku, Urogi, and Aizetsu, who reacted with a strong glare as Tanjiro told him to stop protecting his Fear counterpart. He asked him if he had a problem with what he was doing, calling the pair of Demon Slayers evil, as the mini Hantengu cowered and trembled in his wooden protection. He answered Tanjiro's question of why he had said they were evil by pointing out their attack on his smaller version, something he called "pure injustice" and something "only a savage would do". He stood impassively as Tanjiro pointed out his misdeeds, promising to cut the Hatred Demon's head off.Infuriated by the boy's defiance, Zohakuten, beat one of his drums again and sent his 5 dragons on the Demon Slayers. Tanjiro, Nezuko, and Genya were quickly overwhelmed in their battle against the Upper Rank, with Tanjiro deducing that Zohakuten not only possessed the abilities of the original 4 clones, as his attacks included Sekido's lightning attacks, Karaku's wind blasts, and Urogi's sonic screeches, but also that their potency had been amplified, as the latter two broke his foot and burst his eardrums respectively. He also estimated that the dragons could extend to 66 ft. Two dragons ensnared Nezuko and Genya in their coils, and when Tanjiro tried to get 66 ft away, one created multiple dragons from it's mouth like a Russian doll, and grabbed Tanjiro by the arm, pulling him towards his mouth and swallowing him whole, much to Nezuko and Genya's horror. When the dragon began to crush Tanjiro with it's innards, Zohakuten triumphantly declared his victory, believing that the boy was good as dead. But at that moment, the Love Hashira, Mitsuri Kanroji, sliced open the dragon that swallowed Tanjiro and rescued him, while reacting with horror at the monsters that Zohakuten had summoned. Still holding Nezuko and Genya hostage, the demon glared at and insulted the "damn slip of a girl." Confident, Mitsuri charged into battle, despite Tanjiro's warnings of Zohakuten's status. Mitsuri was able to destroy a dragon and outmaneuver the rest, but she later paused the fight for a moment attempting to assertively and diplomatically order Nezuko and Genya's release. The demon spitefully rejected this, calling her a "shameless tramp" and boldly declaring that there is only one person in the world who could give him orders, referring to Muzan. Zohakuten then tried to kill Mitsuri using Blood Demon Art: Crazed Cry of Thunderdeath, a combination of Sekido's lighting and Urogi's screaming. To his surprise however, she was able to combat this with Love Breathing, slicing through his lighting. Growing more agitated by her also being able to counter Karaku's wind blasts and Aizetsu's "Weeping Spear" projectiles, Zohakuten attempted to bury Mitsuri with a BDA known as "Countless Striking Trees", an attack meant to overwhelm her by summoning a multitude of dragons. He also used this opportunity to to relocate the cluster of branches protecting Hantengu's body. After Mitsuri successfully slashed and destroyed Zohakuten's dragons, she attempted to use her long, flexible sword to decapitate him, but Zohakuten opened his mouth and began to power up his own sonic screech. Although the girl was confident, Tanjiro yelled that decapitating Zohakuten wouldn't defeat him, causing her to let her guard down and attempt to move out of the way. Before she could however, Zohakuten directly hit her with an extremely powerful sonic screech dubbed "Compressed Sound Waves". To his shock however, Mitsuri's body was not only still intact, but she had survived the attack, only being knocked unconscious. Hopping off the cluster of branches he was using as podium, Zohakuten walked towards her, baffled how she had survived an attack that should had completely annihilated her. He then realized that her slim physique hid her true muscle density, and excitedly decided to eat her flesh in order to gain strength, after he pulverized her skull and tissue. Before Zohakuten could land a killing blow on Kanroji, Tanjiro, and the recently escaped Nezuko and Genya came to her aid, and pushed her out the way. When they attempted to carry the Hashira to safety, an unimpressed Zohakuten attempted to finish all 4 of them with a powerful lighting attack, but Mitsuri had once again sliced trough it, now with new-found motivation. Summoning even more dragons, Zohakuten and Mitsuri engaged in combat once again, with her ordering her comrades to go after the main body. Any attempt to stop the Kamado siblings and Genya from reaching it was halted by the Love Hashira, who destroyed any dragon that approached them. Confused and furious, Zohakuten questioned how Mitsuri's attacks were more faster and powerful then before, before noticing a Demon Slayer Mark had appeared on her neck, which he remarked looked like a demon's crest. Although beyond frustrated with the girl thwarting his attacks, he knew that her stamina was finite, and she'll eventually run out of it like all humans do. Now in a location away from the battle, Hantengu continued to cower in the cluster of branches he was encased in. When Tanjiro, Genya, and Nezuko attempted to attack the cluster, it suddenly became animated and ensnared the 3, and then began moving at an extremely fast speed in order to shake them off. Genya bit the wood in order to gain strength and successfully chewed it in half. The half that contained Hantengu then tried to defend itself using flailing branches that acted like whips, although with help of Nezuko's blood demon art, Tanjiro was able to slice it open. However, Hantengu had somehow escaped and was attempting to sneak away, but he was quickly detected. Infuriated by the demon's cowardice, Tanjiro angrily ordered the demon to face the consequences for his actions, while Hantengu fled from the slayers. Tanjiro's words of condemnation gave him vague flashbacks of the magistrate who had sentenced him to death so long ago, causing the demon to tearfully lament how nobody had showed him any sympathy despite his apparent "virtue." As he continued to flee, the 3 young slayers began to give chase. Although trying their best to catch up to the demon, Hantengu's speed and small size made it a fruitless endeavor, and the demon was quickly outrunning the three. However, using a memory of his close ally Zenitsu Agatsuma, giving a brief lesson on how to utilize Thunder Breathing, Tanjiro was able to build enough force into his legs and use Thunder Breathing to catch up to Hantengu. The boy then ignited his sword with Hinokami Kagura and attempted to behead the main body once again. However, after asking if he felt the least bit sorry for him, Hantengu suddenly transformed into an angry, hulking, behemoth and began to strangle Tanjiro, while admonishing him for "bullying the weak." Genya was able to catch up and desperately tried to pry the demon's giant hands open to free Tanjiro, but both were hit by Hantengu using another sonic screech attack, although this one was weaker and only momentarily stunned them. Nezuko then used her BDA to set the giant demon alight, which disoriented him enough for Genya to rip his arms off and release Tanjiro, who continued his attempt to behead the demon. However, Hantengu began to run backwards, pulling Tanjiro with him, and fell off a cliff in order to shake him off, with Nezuko jumping as well on order to save her brother. After they landed, Hantengu, with the sword still lodged in his neck, was unable to regenerate his arms, noting that Zohakuten's was using too much of his power, causing his regeneration to slow down. He was able to detect some humans nearby, and decided to eat them in order to replenish his power, but Tanjiro, who had landed in a tree called out to him, vowing to kill him. Taken aback, and infuriated by his defiance, Hantengu ran off, desperately searching for the humans he had sensed. He eventually found three swordsman villagers, and gave them chase when they spotted him and fled. Believing that the Kamado's no longer posed a significant threat, he was then taken by surprise when Tanjiro had caught up to him using Thunder Breathing once again. The boy had been armed with the old sword of Yoriichi Tsugikuni, the man who Sekido earlier recognized as the swordsman who nearly decapitated Muzan, and using that sword Tanjiro was finally able to decapitate the giant demon. The headless body of Hantengu began to wobble for a bit, but Tanjiro who believed that he had vanquished demon, desperately tried to hide his sister, who had just woken up after being knocked unconscious by her earlier fall, from the approaching sunlight. However, Nezuko desperately ran towards Tanjiro's direction, and when the boy tried to stop her, she pointed towards the distance, revealing that Hantengu had regrown his arms and was still alive, chasing the 3 villagers from earlier in an attempt to consume them. Tanjiro then noticed the decapitated head of the giant demon, and realized that it's tongue had the word "resentment" inscribed, instead of "fear", like the miniature demon from earlier. The giant demon had turned out to be another emotion clone, this one by the name of Urami, and the true main body was still yet to be killed. The Kamados briefly tried to finish the job, but the sun finally came out and began to burn Nezuko alive, causing Tanjiro to stay for the sake of his sister. Meanwhile, Urami was also burning the the sunlight, although his tough, muscular exterior made the process slower, and Tanjiro noted that he would've already killed the villagers by the time he finished burning. Unable to resolve his dilemma on whether to save his sister or the villagers, Nezuko kicked him off, forcing him to save the villagers at her expense. With the belief that his only remaining family was dead, Tanjiro, filled with grief and rage, rushed towards Urami, and used his sense of smell to detect the location of Hantengu's main body, which was inside Urami's heart. After catching up with the demon, Tanjiro severed Urami's arms that had grabbed the heads of the villagers, and then sliced open his body, causing Hantengu's true miniature body to fall out. Demanding that the cowardly demon atone for its sins with its life, Tanjiro used his burning blade to slash Hantengu's neck. Hantengu then remembered his life as an elderly human criminal, his murder of a man who called out his duplicity, his final trial with the magistrate, and his first encounter with Muzan. He seemed genuinely surprised that his life was flashing before his eyes, with his final flashback being the magistrate telling him that one day his sins would catch up to him. Hantengu then realized that day had arrived. Cutting back to the present, Tanjiro continued his attempt to decapitate the demon, and although Hantengu tried to use Urami to push the boy off, after a long, slow, and excruciating slice, Hantengu was finally beheaded once and for all. Due to his decapitation, coupled with with the exposure to sunlight, Hantengu, and what was left of Urami's body, instantly disintegrated. However, milliseconds before his death, Hantengu was able to catch a glimpse of Nezuko Kamado, who had survived exposure to the sunlight and reported it to his lord, Muzan Kibutsuji. Back in the forest, Mitsuri was still fighting Zohakuten, as just as the demon predicted, she had finally ran out of stamina, and had tearfully accepted that her death was imminent. However, right as a dragon swallowed Mitsuri, Hantengu's death finally caught up and both Zohakuten and the dragon disintegrated, with the child demon reacting with only mild surprise, but was otherwise silent. With the death of the most powerful and dangerous of Hantengu's clones, the Upper Rank's reign of terror had finally come to an end. However, although Gyokko and Hantengu had both failed in their mission to annihilate the swordsmith village, with both the demons dying at the hands of demon slayers, Muzan was overjoyed that a demon had finally survived the sunlight, and praised Hantengu for his unintentional scouting. The king of demons then decided to finally come out of hiding and personally search for Nezuko, so he could finally achieve his long sought goal of immortality. Legacy. When discussing the attack on the Swordsmith village with his Kakushi ally Goto, Tanjiro remarked on the power of Hantengu’s clones, calling them powerful foes. He recalled Karaku blasting Muichiro away, Sekido electrocuting him, Aizetsu impaling Genya, Urogi stunning him with his sonic screech, Zohakuten using Countless Striking Trees, and Urami strangling him. Following Hantengu's death, the position of Upper Four was taken by Nakime. When Mitsuri Kanroji and the Serpent Hashira Obanai Iguro, encountered the demon, they reacted with surprise on how quickly Muzan replaced the former Upper Rank.

Hashira The are the highest-ranking Demon Slayers in the Demon Slayer Corps. Overview. Hashira is the highest rank that Demon Slayers can obtain in the Demon Slayer Corps. Those who hold the position are regarded as the most powerful and skilled combatants in the entire organization, protecting humanity against more dangerous threats that cannot be handled by other Demon Slayers. The Hashira, in accordance with their great strength, hold the highest authority in the organization, second only to the Corps leader, Kagaya Ubuyashiki, and later, Kiriya Ubuyashiki. The Hashira are all assigned a specific region that they are required to patrol, usually to gather information about the demons inhabiting said area and to improve their swordsmanship. They are also deployed on missions only if lower-ranking members are unable to complete it. Each Hashira is the master of a unique Breathing Style, some of which are even created by themselves. Interestingly, swordsmen who can use Flame Breathing and Water Breathing have become Hashira in every era, with no exceptions thus far. Joining. To be a member of the Hashira, a Demon Slayer must be among the strongest combatants in the entirety of the Demon Slayer Corps. There are two known methods (both extremely difficult) that allow one to prove that they are worthy of becoming a Hashira: the first method is to accumulate a demon kill count of at least 50 as a Kinoe-ranked Demon Slayer, or slay a member of the Twelve Kizuki. The second method is being a Tsuguko of a Hashira, which requires immense talent. Additionally, Tsuguko can only inherit the rank, if their respective Hashira dies or retires. The effort required to achieve either of these methods requires almost five years' worth of training, though, the talented might take only two or so years to do so. However, there was one example that was much faster than that; Muichiro Tokito, who managed to rise to the rank of Hashira just two months after joining the Demon Slayer Corps. Finding Successors. In some cases, an exceptionally talented Demon Slayer can become the designated successor to one of the Hashira, known as a Tsuguko. To become a Tsuguko, a Demon Slayer can either apply for the position and get accepted, or get scouted by one of the current Hashira . Hashira Training. In preparation for the upcoming confrontation with Muzan Kibutsuji, Kagaya Ubuyashiki ordered that the Hashira conduct special training sessions with lower-ranked Demon Slayers. to improve all the Demon Slayers' physical abilities, overall health, and condition. The Hashira also trained among each other to improve their individual strength and their cooperative attack coordination. List of Known Hashira. <tabber> Anime = Anime Status. Hashira Training The is a training program held by the Demon Slayer Corps. It was conducted by the Hashira and undertaken by numerous lower-ranked Demon Slayers. The training took place before the final battle. Overview. The goals of the training program are twofold: This training method has proven to be very effective in the final battle where the majority of Demon Slayers were able to effectively kill Lower Rank-level demons regardless of their ranking. Training program. Each of the Hashira oversees a different component of the training program for lower-ranking Demon Slayers, which includes basic stamina training, flexibility training, quick movement training, sword skill training, pounding training, and muscle reinforcement training. The training sessions are extremely strenuous; because of this, a majority of the Demon Slayers view the training session as an everlasting trip in hell, with a few notable exceptions who see the session as a chance to improve themselves. The components of the program include sessions with each Hashira on their respective training ground in the following order: As a general rule, Hashira must take part in each other's training sessions. It is considered a win-win situation for both the Hashira and the Demon Slayers, as even the Hashira get to improve due to constantly facing waves upon waves of junior swordsmen ranked lower than themselves. This accelerates their heart rate and temperature, which might help with unlocking the Demon Slayer Mark. Those who already have marks will train to continuously stay in the marked state. Other than the sessions with the lower-ranked Demon Slayers, the Hashira also battle one on one using their own Breathing Styles with wooden swords. The purpose is to coordinate their attacks while using two different kind of breathing styles, so they won't interfere each other's attacks during a future battle that is moving at a high pace. Giyu Tomioka, the Water Hashira, initially did not take part in the training sessions for lower-ranked Hashira, but later joined the training after encouragement from Tanjiro. Shinobu Kocho, the Insect Hashira, was the only Hashira who completely did not participate in any training sessions due to the significant amount of time she needed to prepare poison for the Final Battle. After the Hashira meeting, she informed Gyomei of this choice, who accepted this. History. After the events in the Swordsmith Village, Amane Ubuyashiki held an emergency Hashira Meeting. She informs the Hashira that since Nezuko Kamado is able to conquer the sun, Muzan will go after her and the time for an all-out battle against him and the demons is approaching soon. Since Demon Slayer Marks started appearing after Tanjiro Kamado unlocked his first, she requests the Hashira to train themselves to unlock their marks and that any Demon Slayers with marks regardless of their status must participate. The Hashira agree. Gyomei Himejima then announces to the other Hashira that he has a proposition on how to tackle this. Sharing the idea of a training program, he requested every Hashira to set the contents of their training and get their preparations done for it. Because of their busy schedule which includes protecting their assigned regions, gathering information on demons and improving their swordsmanship, Hashira normally did not having time to train anyone other than their successors, the Tsuguko, but since Nezuko conquered the sun, the demons stopped appearing and Hashira only have to focus on night patrol and day training now. The extra free time allows them to train lower-ranking Demon Slayers as well.

Hashira Training Arc The is the tenth story arc of Kimetsu no Yaiba. Synopsis. Since the day Nezuko Kamado's immunity to sunlight has been revealed, demon attacks have halted. The Demon Slayer Corps knows that with Muzan Kibutsuji is plotting to take her, a new and destructive confrontation is coming. In the calm before the storm, Kagaya enacts strict training for all its members, even the Hashira, and Tanjiro use the grueling process to better himself and know just a little more about the strongest Demon Slayers in the organization.

Hinaki Ubuyashiki is the eldest daughter of Kagaya Ubuyashiki. Appearance. Similar to the rest of her family, Hinaki had pale skin and large, purple eyes. She had white, shoulder-length hair styled into a blunt bob with bangs and sported a red ribbon on the right side of her head. Hinaki was usually seen wearing a dark blue decorated with purple flowers along with a maroon and a pink and juban under everything, nearly identical to her twin sister with her sister Nichika. Personality. Hinaki was usually very quiet, but kind. She loved her father very much and was loyal to him even to the point of dying alongside him. Kiriya describes his older sister as smarter and more skilled than him. History. The eldest daughter of the Ubuyashiki quintuplets. Nothing much is known about Hinaki, but for sure all we know is that she was always loyal to her father and never would stray away from him, she stayed by his side and died with him. Synopsis. Mount Natagumo Arc. Hinaki is seen sitting next to her sister Nichika and father Kagaya while he is informed of the attack of the Spider Family on the Demon Slayers. Abilities. Like her siblings it can be assumed that Hinaki has an enhanced intellect.

Hinatsuru is a supporting character of "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba". She is a and one of Tengen Uzui's wives. Appearance. Hinatsuru is a young woman of average height possessing a curvaceous and slender figure with long black hair that she generally keeps tied back into a ponytail. She has big, almond-shaped violet eyes framed with thin eyelashes and eyebrows and a distinct beauty mark located beneath her left eye, giving her a gentle and kind appearance. Hinatsuru wears a short, sleeveless lavender dress with an irregular square pattern of a darker color, which has a plunging neckline that exposes her cleavage, and secured tight with a red-violet colored obi where she presumably stores her . She wears brown fishnet socks that reach up to her mid-thigh along with light colored sandals with purple straps. In a flashback, she's also seen wearing long, fingerless fishnet gloves. Personality. Hinatsuru's personality is very similar to that of Tanjiro Kamado. Kind, calm, and nurturing, even when dealing with her co-wives' antics towards each other, much like the latter when dealing with Zenitsu and Inosuke's antics. Due to her more understanding and calm personality, Hinatsuru often serves as Tengen's emotional bolster, in ways Makio and Suma cannot. Despite only being slightly older than the two, she displays far more maturity and often acts to mediate situations between them, as seen when Hinatsuru spoke with Makio about Tengen and how he lives his life differently to that of traditional shinobi, despite Makio's confusion. Though generally quiet and and kind, Hinatsuru became angry with Suma and Makio fighting as Tengen lay dying of Gyutaro's poison. She also expressed annoyance when Obanai demeaned Tengen for his efforts just to kill the weakest of the Upper Ranks. History. At some point of her life, Hinatsuru married Tengen Uzui, along with Suma and Makio. After she left the clan, her family journeyed to see Kagaya Ubuyashiki in order to fight as a part of the Demon Slayer Corps. At some point in the past, Hinatsuru was instructed alongside Makio and Suma by Tengen on his personal ideology: to put their own lives first, then respectable humans, and lastly himself. She accepted his will, but Makio questioned the approach as it went against what they had been taught as kunoichi. Hinatsuru reassured her, reminding her that it's what Tengen wanted for them and that it was okay to desire self-preservation. Later, she would bring up her wish for the four of them to retreat from the front lines as soon as they defeated an Upper Rank. Synopsis. Entertainment District Arc. Suspecting that the Entertainment District was an ideal hiding location for demons, Hinatsuru infiltrated it as an alongside her fellow wives. Sent to the Kyogoku House, she quickly realized that the lead oiran Warabihime was a Demon, but could not make a move, and thus drank poison in order to be sent out of the house. However, she was sent off with a sash that would quickly dispatch her if she attempted to do anything suspicious. Sent to the lowest class brothel in Yoshiwara, Kirimise, Hinatsuru was found by her husband Tengen and given an antidote to the poison she had taken. She told him to leave her and go after the demon, apologizing for not being more useful. He instructed her to leave as soon as the antidote took effect, and the two hugged. When she recovered enough to move, she instead slowly made her way towards the fight. Arriving at a critical point in the conflict, Hinatsuru fired a large amount of kunai at Gyutaro, who used a Blood Demon Art to block the attack. Despite this, one of her kunai managed to get through, creating an opportunity for Tengen and Tanjiro Kamado to strike. She desperately hoped that one of them would manage to decapitate the demon. However, the Upper Rank managed to recover and turn his attention to her, but before any harm could come to her, Tanjiro saved her with a combined Water Breathing and Hinokami Kagura technique. She ripped Gyutaro's severed hand from her throat, but he was quickly upon them again, only to be attacked from behind by Tengen. The sneak attack failed, Tanjiro launching the two of them back from the subsequent counterattack, and the sudden attack from Daki. The kunoichi told her savior not to worry about her, as she would hide herself, but to instead focus on winning. Before she left, she slipped him one of her poisoned kunai. She was joined by her fellow wives, Makio and Suma, having witnessed the final moments of the battle. She noted with worry that something was wrong, that feeling becoming horrifying reality in a desperate final attack by Gyutaro. She and the others desperately tried to save their husband, to no avail, Hinatsuru shedding a tear for him. He attempted to say his final words, but Suma and Makio were quarreling, causing Hinatsuru to admonish them. In the middle of all this, Nezuko Kamado arrived, using her Blood Demon Art to burn the poison from Tengen's body, to the wives' initial astonishment and horror, to subsequent joy. Hinatsuru, her fellow wives, and Tengen were then approached by Obanai Iguro, who both congratulated and insulted them on their victory. She pushed an overly emotional Suma off of their heavily injured husband. Swordsmith Village Arc. When Kakushi arrived to survey the battle damage and begin clean up, Hinatsuru then left with her family, supporting her husband so he could walk. Hashira Training Arc. Hinatsuru assists her co-wives during Tengen's stage of Hashira Training, giving out food to the exhausted participants. She greets Tanjiro when he appears to begin his training. Abilities. Overall Abilities: Hinatsuru does not possess any form of superhuman abilities. However, as she was raised as a, Hinatsuru possesses effective and refined shinobi skills, being capable of wielding a as well as performing maneuvers and fighting much more proficiently than regular people can. Additionally, though not on the level of Demon Slayers, Hinatsuru's training has provided her with above average physical abilities, quickly recovering from a poison only hours after taking an antidote, enough that she could help in battle, and leaping away from Daki's incoming obi with impressive height and speed. Equipment. Large Crossbow: In the battle against Gyutaro, Hinatsuru uses a large crossbow to fire a barrage of kunai at the Upper Rank in an attempt to slow down his regeneration. Standard Kunai: As a, Hinatsuru carries around two standard black for combat purposes. Wisteria-Laced Kunai: Hinatsuru possesses a box which is filled with numerous kunai. Each kunai is laced with wisteria poison strong enough to paralyze normal demons half a day and even capable of immobilizing the Twelve Kizuki's Lower Rank demons.

Hinokami Kagura is a Breathing Style only known and taught by the, later revealed to be the first Breathing Style, . Overview. The Hinokami Kagura is a Breathing Style that is passed on from father to son in every generation of alongside the earrings. They use it within a ritual ceremony practiced every new year, where the Breathing Style user offers the Fire God a dance from sunset to sunrise to ward off threats and diseases. The dance is composed of twelve segments repeated throughout the night until dawn. Tanjuro Kamado noted that the breathing technique utilized in this dance allows the user to never exhaust themselves no matter how long they move, making it such that they can seemingly dance forever. The last user of Hinokami Kagura is Tanjiro Kamado, who learned the Breathing Style from his father Tanjuro Kamado. Other people can learn this technique if taught by a Kamado descendant. The Hinokami Kagura is later revealed by Shinjuro Rengoku to be a legendary Breathing Style known as, the first one to have ever been created, though it was seemingly lost. All other Breathing Styles are derived from it as the result of Yoriichi Tsugikuni, its creator, modifying it to suit the individuals he taught who were unable to use it. Both the Hinokami Kagura and Sun Breathing are Breathing Styles that mimic the sun and replicate it with the user's movements, techniques, and abilities. All techniques and forms are extremely varied and have no set pattern, making it the most versatile and effective against demons. Users of Sun Breathing visualize themselves seemingly manipulating solar flames when unleashing its techniques. Tanjiro noted that using this style increases his overall power and speed, which may be due to the fact that his body is more suited to Sun Breathing as opposed to Water Breathing. Upon seeing Yoriichi perform the twelve forms of Sun Breathing through his ancestor's memories, Tanjiro realized that, despite being replicated with a surprising degree of accuracy for hundreds of years and his own mastery of Hinokami Kagura, it had unnecessary movements, such as different wrist angles, footwork and breathing rhythm, compared to the Sun Breathing directly performed by Yoriichi. Removing them enabled him to use the Breathing Style in its purest form, to the point where Muzan Kibutsuji saw Yoriichi's visage overlapping with Tanjiro's own when he was performing the techniques against him. Known Techniques. Sun Breathing was initially created with 12 techniques all connected to one another by Yoriichi Tsugikuni. Later upon meeting Muzan Kibutsuji, Yoriichi perfected his swordsmanship form, creating a new unnamed thirteenth form. Demonstrations. <tabber> </tabber>

Hiroshi Shinazugawa was a younger brother of Sanemi and Genya Shinazugawa. Appearance. Hiroshi was a boy of average height for his age, with large round blue eyes and a light skin tone. His hair was shaved along the sides, except for a small crop at the top of his head styled into a mohawk. He bore a great resemblance to his brother Genya and his mother. Hiroshi wore a navy blue kimono and grey pants. Personality. Hiroshi was a loving and caring child, much like his siblings. He became worried for his mother's safety when she did not come home and decided to stay up all night till she arrived, eagerly rushing to greet her when she came home eventually. He also loved his siblings in the same way, as he addressed his older brother Genya when he awoke up to see him awake and Sanemi gone. History. Hiroshi was born to Kyogo Shinazugawa and his wife Shizu. He had 6 other siblings, the oldest two being Sanemi and Genya. Though his father was incredibly abusive to his family, Hiroshi was often protected from his outbursts by his mother. Some time later, Kyogo would meet a violent end by getting stabbed to death in a grudge. One night, their mother was late to come home. As Hiroshi, Sumi, Teiko, Koto, and Shuya slept, Sanemi decided to go out to look for. Genya stayed behind to watch the rest of them and they woke up shortly afterwards. As they waited for their mother, they became concerned as she had never been so late before, with Genya trying to ease their worries and asking them to go back to sleep. A loud knock then rang from the front door, leading Hiroshi, Sumi, Teiko, and Shuya to run and greet their mother. Despite Genya's warning that the figure outside may not be her, the door broke open. Their mother, who had transformed into a demon, entered and killed the four instantly. Synopsis. Swordsmith Village Arc. In his battle with Upper Rank Four Hantengu, Genya tries but fails to cut through his durable neck. In that moment, the demon's manifestation of anger appeared behind him and prepared to stab him in the head. Realizing he cannot dodge the blow, Genya's life flashed before his eyes, reminiscing on his past and the death of his siblings and his mother. Sunrise Countdown Arc. Following the defeat of Muzan Kibutsuji, Sanemi found himself in the afterlife as his life faded from his wounds. He saw that in heaven was Hiroshi, amongst their other siblings.

Hisa is an elderly lady who welcomes Demon Slayers to rest in her house. Tanjiro Kamado and his group visit her after they fight Kyogai at the Tsuzumi Mansion. Appearance. Hisa is a short, old woman with wrinkled skin and thick eyebrows. Her bulky, gray hair is tied into a medium sized bun with two strands poking out behind her ears. In most of her appearances, Hisa is seen wearing a plain maroon with a purple with black and white . Personality. Hisa comes off as a very kind and welcoming person, bringing in the injured Demon Slayers without hesitation and providing them with commodities for recovery. Despite Inosuke Hashibira's and Zenitsu Agatsuma impolite nature, she proved to be very patient with them and doesn't appear to be affected by their remarks. Inosuke noted that even with his enhanced perception, Hisa's kind demeanor made it impossible for him to detect her presence because she bore no ounce of ill-will towards him. History. Hisa's family was once saved by the Demon Slayers and they started managing a free rest house for them as a token of gratitude for their work. Synopsis. Tsuzumi Mansion Arc. Following their battle at the Tsuzumi Mansion, Tanjiro, Zenitsu, and Inosuke are guided by Tanjiro's Ksaugai Crow to Hisa's lodging for rest and recovery. Opening the door to the commotion outside, Hisa greets the three Demon Slayers and offers them to come in; Inosuke begins poking her, to Tanjiro's annoyance, but she leads them in without notice him. Inside the house, Hisa provides them with new clothes and food. After eating, she provides them with futons to sleep in and introduces them to a doctor to treat their injuries. After the three have recovered, they are directed to their new mission in the forests of Mount Natagumo. Before they depart, Hisa strike a kiribe flint to bid them good luck on their mission. Confused, Inosuke angrily yells at her, causing Tanjiro to hold him back and Zenitsu to stand in front of Hisa, though she does not mind his behavior. Infinity Castle Arc. As Tanjiro watches Giyu Tomioka fight Akaza, he recalls a conversation he had with Inosuke regarding the ability to sense danger through his body. Inosuke notes that while he can detect bloodlust through even a glance at him, Hisa's kind personality inadvertently enabled her to sneak up on him due to her possessing no negative emotions whatsoever. Abilities. As an ordinary human, she doesn't posses any additional powers or abilities.

Horned Demon The was a demon that lived in the Tsuzumi Mansion. Appearance. The Horned Demon has shoulder length black hair, with a center split and a single horn in the middle of his forehead. He has distinct red eyes with vertical pupils, slanted in an upward position, as well as thick protruding lips. The Horned Demon had a large physical build, with visible veins displayed on the majority of his body. He wore green pants with a brown vest. Personality. The Horned Demon was prideful and confident, as seen when he showed no hesitation to attack at the sight of Inosuke Hashibira, even boasting about the fact that he'd soon taste Inosuke's flesh and sarcastically complimenting his attack. However, his pride and lack of caution quickly became his downfall as he underestimated Inosuke, showing a lack of ability to properly size up his opponent before fighting them. History. Inside the Tsuzumi Mansion, he and the Tongue Demon got into a scuffle with Kyogai over who would get to eat Kiyoshi, a boy Kyogai had found and wanted to devour for his Marechi blood. During the confrontation, the Horned Demon managed to rip off one of Kyogai's tsuzumi, which Kiyoshi quickly grabbed and used to transport himself to safety. The three demons then wandered the mansion in search of Kiyoshi. Synopsis. While running through the halls of the mansion, Inosuke was nearly grabbed by the Horned Demon as he was turning at a corner. The demon deemed him a "fresh human" and tried again to grab his prey. However, Inosuke slashed off both of the demon's arm and used his Beast Breathing, Third Fang: Devour to slice off the Horned Demon's head, before using the body to launch himself for another search around the mansion. Abilities. Physical Abilities. Enhanced Strength: The Horned Demon was able to rip out one of Kyogai's tsuzumi from his back, which would have taken a large amount of strength. He is also shown to easily crush hard wood simply by grabbing it, seen when he tried to grab Inosuke. Quotes. (To Inosuke) "It'll be a treat to carve away your flesh."
