Zenitsu Agatsuma/Relationships Relationships. Tanjiro Kamado. Zenitsu depends on Tanjiro quite frequently during intense situations early on such as when they come into contact with Demons. This was due to Zenitsu's low self-esteem and a self-deprecating belief that he was a weakling, and because Tanjiro was less likely to experience fear. Zenitsu respects and admires his leadership but also ridicules him out of jealousy whenever Tanjiro mentions his encounters with females without Zenitsu. He also frequently gets frustrated by Tanjiro's bravery and heroism, seeing it as unnecessarily suicidal and getting dragged into dangerous situations because of it. Nevertheless, Zenitsu greatly values their friendship due to Tanjiro's immense kindness and patience, and is brave enough to do what Tanjiro tells him to at the risk of his wellbeing. He's quite possibly Zenitsu's first legitimate friend in his entire life. They cooperate well during battles. Nezuko Kamado. Despite having an intense fear of Demons, Zenitsu develops a crush on Nezuko. He tries to convince her to marry him several times and never fails to mention his admiration for her whenever he sees her. However, later down the line, Zenitsu eventually calms down around Nezuko and becomes slightly less aggressive. He often tells her stories about the rehabilitation training session which he does with Tanjiro which she missed out on, how Tanjiro cheers Zenitsu on during said rehabilitation training, and he promises at one point to take her to a flower field. Additionally, he had let Nezuko look at Shinobu Kocho's goldfish without Shinobu's permission Zenitsu also protects Nezuko multiple times when she is in danger, evident during Zenitsu's first meeting with Inosuke Hashibira and the battle against Enmu in the train. Eventually Zenitsu and Nezuko would marry and start a family as evidenced by their descendants. Kaigaku. Both Zenitsu and Kaigaku trained under Jigoro Kuwajima as successors to the Thunder Hashira. Regardless of the shared animosity between them, Zenitsu holds a great deal of respect towards him, going so far as to punch other members of the Demon Slayer Corps that talked badly about him behind his back. Kaigaku, on the other hand, always belittled Zenitsu and called him "dirt" due to his lack of strength. Kaigaku's personality ultimately proved to be a stark contrast to Zenitsu's. While both were afraid of demons, Zenitsu decided that he would continue fighting against them and remain loyal to the Demon Slayer Corps. Kaigaku, on the other hand, would eventually decide to betray the Demon Slayer Corps and become a demon himself when Kokushibo gave him a chance to join the Twelve Kizuki in an attempt to spare his life. During the Hashira training, Zenitsu gives off a different, more serious vibe as if he is focused on something important. When going up against Kaigaku, Zenitsu is stern, he constantly insults Kaigaku and is described as suddenly becoming a different person by Kaigaku himself. Despite how Zenitsu acts towards Kaigaku, in the past he had always respected him even if he hated him. Zenitsu is able to admit that Kaigaku was special and important to him just like his Gramps. At the end of the battle, as Zenitsu falls he says he wished to use his own technique, Honoikazuchi no Kami beside Kaigaku in battle one day, together. Following the fight, when Zenitsu sees Jigoro, his own Gramps before him, he can't help but cry and apologize for not getting along with Kaigaku. Zenitsu thought that if he hadn't existed, Kaigaku wouldn't have became a demon and instead he would become something different. Zenitsu felt like Jigoro deserved to be paid back for helping him, so he apologizes for not being able to pay him back. Jigoro Kuwajima. Jigoro first met Zenitsu when he saved him from a financial dilemma, taking it upon himself to train the young boy to become a swordsman and receiving a lot of respect and appreciation from the latter as a result. Under Jigoro's mentorship, Zenitsu learned the Thunder Breathing alongside another student, Kaigaku. Jigoro was strict to Zenitsu due to his inexperience, but he nevertheless continued teaching him without giving up. Zenitsu held a great deal of familial love for his mentor, often referring to him informally as "Gramps" rather than "Master". When it is later revealed to Zenitsu that his master committed seppuku alone after Kaigaku willingly allowed himself to be transformed into a Demon, he becomes both shocked and enraged towards the latter, feeling immense grief and pain over his father figure's departure. However, his passing causes Zenitsu to immediately focus on his training in order to personally lay his mentor's regret to rest by becoming strong enough to kill Kaigaku and redeem Jigoro's name. Following Kaigaku's defeat, Zenitsu encountered Jigoro once more in the afterlife. Zenitsu apologized to him for not getting along with Kaigaku, yet before he could return to the land of the living, Jigoro declared to Zenitsu that he was his pride and joy. Sometime later, Jigoro was cremated. Zenitsu kept his late mentor's ashes as he moved into the Kamado household with Tanjiro, Nezuko, and Inosuke. Inosuke Hashibira. Zenitsu and Inosuke usually do not get along despite being on the same team mainly due to their extremely low opinions of each other and their wildly contrasting personalities, Zenitsu being easily frightened while Inosuke being fearless. Inosuke sees Zenitsu as annoying, loud, weak (initially) and a crybaby; while Zenitsu sees Inosuke as a violent moron who's only interested in fighting. However, in dire situations, they can cooperate well. Inosuke shows a level of admiration for Zenitsu's abilities while asleep, saying he should sleep forever after seeing how cool he fights for the first time. Shinobu Kocho. Zenitsu appears to be very fond of Shinobu's presence due to her good looks and her friendliness towars him. He blushes when he sees her and gets very active after she holds his hand and encourages him to do his recovery training. Zenitsu also believes that Shinobu could get by in life with just her looks alone.

Zenitsu Agatsuma/Synopsis History. Zenitsu was not raised by his parents so he did not have any proper guidance. When he was young, Zenitsu fell in love with a girl and decided to give her money to appeal to her, however the girl ended up running away with another guy leaving Zenitsu drowning in debt. Seeing that he was in financial trouble with debt collectors, Jigoro Kuwajima paid off the debt for Zenitsu and decided to train him as a swordsman. Zenitsu began to refer to Jigoro as 'Gramps' and began to train alongside Gramps' other disciple, Kaigaku. One day when he was training, Zenitsu climbed up a tree out of fear that he was being trained to death and as he began to panic, a stroke of lightning hit him causing his hair to turn blonde. Zenitsu and Kaigaku hated each other. However, Zenitsu still respected him as his senior and for his strong ambition. Zenitsu wished to fight alongside Kaigaku as equals one day and developed his own seventh form, Honoikazuchi no Kami. Synopsis. Final Selection Arc. Zenitsu is first seen at the beginning of the Final Selection at Mt. Fujikasane. After the Final Selection, Zenitsu is among the four people who have passed. Zenitsu is seen talking to himself; fearing he will die one day. Each one received a Kasugai Crow; except Zenitsu who got a sparrow. All four are told to choose what ore they want their sword made out of. Tsuzumi Mansion Arc. Zenitsu is seen begging a random girl to marry him. Tanjiro Kamado stops Zenitsu, and excuses the girl. Zenitsu explains that he must get married before his next mission, because he might die; he asks Tanjiro to protect him until he gets married. Tanjiro asks him why he became a Demon Slayer. Zenitsu got swindled by a woman, and racked up debt. An old man paid off his debt, and trained him. Later on, the two share a rice ball as they travel to the south for their next mission. Zenitsu and Tanjiro arrive at a large house in the woods. Tanjiro smells an unfamiliar scent, and Zenitsu hears a strange sound. There are two kids nearby, frozen with fear: Shoichi and Teruko. Tanjiro shows them Zenitsu's sparrow; to try and calm them. The kids tell them about a monster who has taken their brother inside that house, and that they tracked the monster here. Tanjiro ensures them that him and Zenitsu will rescue their brother, and defeat the monster. Zenitsu asks about a non stop sound of a tsuzumi strike. Once the rest finally hear it; a bloody body is thrown out of the house, and lands in front of them. The body is not that of the children's brother. Tanjiro leaves his box with the two kids for protection. Although Zenitsu refuses to enter the house at first; he forces himself to join Tanjiro. Once inside; Tanjiro tells Zenitsu about his broken bones that haven't healed fully yet. Which scares Zenitsu even more, since he can't rely much on Tanjiro for protection. The two kids are frightened by scratching coming from the box, and come inside the house after Zenitsu and Tanjiro. The house begins to rumble, and Tanjiro and Teruko are teleported to a random room in the house; while Zenitsu is left with Shoichi. While searching for the exit, Zenitsu and Shoichi find Inosuke; who runs past them. A scared Zenitsu and Shoichi wander through the house when a demon sneaks up on them. A demon corners the two in a room, and Zenitsu passes out from fear. As the demon tries to strike them; Zenitsu cuts his tongue off. While unconscious; Zenitsu quickly defeats the demon. Zenitsu wakes up with no recollection of his actions, and thanks Shoichi for defeating the demon. Zenitsu and Shoichi enter a room, and the room rotates; throwing them out of a window. Once outside, they see Inosuke run out of the house. Inosuke attempts to attack Nezuko who is inside the box, Zenitsu protects Nezuko's box from Inosuke. Zenitsu explains his great hearing, and that he can hear living things breathing, heartbeat, and their blood circulation. Zenitsu knew Tanjiro was traveling with a demon, and tells Inosuke to back off; as he is going to ask Tanjiro himself; why he's traveling with a demon. Inosuke continuously attacks Zenitsu; in attempt to kill Nezuko. Tanjiro attacks Inosuke to stop him, and the two begin to fight. Inosuke passes out from Tanjiro's headbutt. After burying the dead they found inside the house; a Crow sends the three Demon Slayers to a house for them to rest in. An elderly lady attends to them while they are there. It is here where he first meets Nezuko and becomes smitten by her. Mount Natagumo Arc. Zenitsu, Tanjiro and Inosuke head to Mount Natagumo for their next mission. They reach their destination at night. They meet a Demon Slayer laying on the ground; who begs them for help as he is pulled into the forest by spider threads. Out of fear Zenitsu refuses to go into the forest; Tanjiro and Inosuke proceed without him. Zenitsu contemplates about not joining his friends. Zenitsu realizes that Tanjiro took Nezuko along with him, and runs in after them to protect Nezuko. While running through the forest; Zenitsu sees a human head with a spider's body. Zenitsu runs away only to stumble across the demon responsible for turning these humans into spider slaves. Zenitsu is bit by a spider, and only has 30 minutes before he also turns into a spider. Zenitsu faints from fear, and begins to fight while unconscious. Zenitsu has a flashback of his teacher who encouraged and never abandoned him, and his senior disciple who always looked down on him. Zenitsu is only able to do the first form, but honed it to perfection; defeating the demon with the Thunder Breathing, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash, Six Fold. Shinobu saves Zenitsu from the poison after he attempts to slow it with his breathing, allowing him to survive long enough for her to administer an antidote to stop it. He is later patched up by the Kakushi and taken to the Butterfly Mansion to recover. Rehabilitation Training Arc. He complains to Kiyo Terauchi about the medicine he has to take. Tanjiro, Goto and Aoi Kanzaki arrive, with the latter scolding Zenitsu for his constant complaining. Tanjiro and Zenitsu renuite, the scarred youth asking his friend if he is alright, and Zenitsu responding by bitterly complaining about everything he has been through since the Mount Natagumo incident. Tanjiro asks Zenitsu about Inosuke and Murata, and the towheaded youth tells him that Inosuke is right next to him. Tanjiro asks Inosuke to forgive him for not coming back to help him, but is told not to worry about it. Dumbfounded by Inosuke's different sounding voice, Tanjiro is told by Zenitsu about their friend's condition: a badly injured throat. After a rundown of Tanjiro, Zenitsu, Inosuke, and Nezuko's respective conditions, the four comrades take a much deserved rest. They are later visited by Murata, who explains what happened to him when he was summoned to the Hashira Meeting, and Shinobu, who tells them that their Rehabilitation training was about to begin. Zenitsu muses over his medical treatment and the condition of the other people turned into spiders. He then thinks about Shinobu and her treatment of these individuals, noting that her sound is irregular and somewhat unsettling. He goes on to note that Tanjiro and Inosuke had been taken by her to undergo the Rehabilitation training and had come back extremely exhausted and bedraggled, causing him to despair, as he was to join the training the next day. The next day, Zenitsu joins his friends at the training, where Aoi Kanzaki explains that there are three parts: a massage to loosen the body, reflex training with Kanao involving medicated bath inside teacups, and whole body training, which is essentially tag, with Kanao and herself. An irate Zenitsu takes his friends aside and chastises them, annoyed that they had been "fooling around" with girls but had come back to the room looking so miserable. A confused Tanjiro asks his towheaded friend what in the world he is talking about, but the maddened youth tells him to shut up, explaining that this training involves a lot of physical contact, which essentially translates into being touched by the girls on a frequent basis, something he sees as pure bliss. Inosuke, also irritated at this point, says that Zenitsu doesn't know what he is talking about, stating that he'll die inside when he loses to someone with a smaller body, only to mocked by his friend. All three of them then got started with the training, with Zenitsu succeeding due to his love of women, but Inosuke making things difficult for everybody due to his hatred of losing. Despite the overall positive performances of his two friends, Tanjiro continues to lose. He is soon joined by his two fellows, however, as neither of them can best Kanao at the reflex training or the whole body training. Over the next five days, the three continue their efforts to beat her, but none of them succeed, causing Zenitsu and Inosuke to give up. Tanjiro continues to persevere, but is unable to make any progress, continuing to lose for another ten days. Having just witnessed Tanjiro beat Kanao during his rehabilitation test, Zenitsu and Inosuke stagger as they try to learn Total Concentration Breathing from Tanjiro. However, despite numerous attempts, the two boys were unable to grasp the concept of the technique and struggle to master it. During one of Tanjiro's lessons, Shinobu interrupts to provide guidance, and words of encouragement to both Inosuke and Zenitsu. The methods she uses to encourage them include, doubting Inosukes ability in order for him to get fired up, as well as tell Zenitsu she's personally "cheering" for him specifically so he gets excited. Nine days pass after her visit, and both Zenitsu and Inosuke have successfully mastered the breathing technique. Elsewhere, Zenitsu is seen leaning up against Nezuko's box as he explains to her the events that had occured that day, while telling her that he'll take her out at night to see flowers that bloom in the garden. After having said goodbye to Sumi, Naho and Kiyo, the trio arrive at the train station. Zenitsu begins to act erratically after realizing that they weren't given any orders and could've remained at the Butterfly Mansion. While trying to deflect Zenitsu's assault, Tanjiro explains his reasoning that they needed to leave in order to find Kyojuro and that it would be easier to receive orders while they're in public. Mugen Train Arc. Tanjiro, Inosuke and Zenitsu stand in front of a train. Inosuke, who has no idea what a train is, describes it as the master of the land and plans to attack it. Zenitsu tries to explain it as a steam engine, but Tanjiro interjects by suggesting that it is a guardian spirit and that they should not attack it. Zenitsu finally explains that it is a vehicle that carries people. Unsurprisingly, Inosuke charges headfirst into the side of the train, which causes a run-in with the police due to the fact that they have swords and also the fact that Inosuke headbutted the train. Soon after, Zenitsu explains that the Demon Slayer Corps are not officially recognized government and that they should conceal the fact that they carry swords. Tanjiro also notes the train is called the 'Infinite Train' and that Kyojuro has probably boarded it already, as Zenitsu proceeds to buy tickets for the train. As they enter the train, Inosuke is his own boisterous self, screaming about being inside the train and causing a ruckus. Zenitsu asks about Kyojuro and Tanjiro describes him as someone with flashy hair and notes that he is very close. The trio suddenly hear loud clamors of "Tasty!" inside the train and trace it to Kyojuro. He is described as a glutton by Zenitsu upon meeting. As a demon appears from the opposite end of the train, Kyojuro notes that he was unable to sense him, but proceeds to draw his sword and manages to finish the demon. Much to their awe, the trio acclaim Kyojuro to train them to which he agrees. Thus, attributing them to call him 'Aniki'. Subsequently, Kyojuro and the trio fall asleep on the train. Within the train, Tanjiro, Kyojuro, Zenitsu, and Inosuke can been seen sleeping soundly. Zenitsu dreams of having a romantic date with Nezuko in a peach orchard. It is pitch black inside Zenitsu's subconscious, as an Enmu's minion stumbles around trying to find his spiritual core. Abruptly, the sound of sharp blades breaks the silence and Zenitsu appears behind the minion holding a large pair of shears. Enraged at finding a boy inside his subconscious, he says only Nezuko is allowed there and attacks the minion. Later on, a sleeping Zenitsu Agatsuma drops in front of Nezuko and manages to not only set Nezuko free but also the other passengers around them in a flash by using Thunder Breathing, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash, Six Fold, he declares that he will protect Nezuko and she looks on in awe. Her admiration is quickly dispelled however, as he pops back asleep mid sentence and begins to snore. Both of them defend three cars of the train from Enmu. After the train is stopped and during the fight between Kyojuro and Akaza, Nezuko falls asleep on the arms of a sleeping Zenitsu as well. After the sunrise, Zenitsu gets her into the box to protect her from the sunlight. Some time later, Zenitsu informed Tanjiro and Inosuke of Kyojuro's heroics, in which he had used an extensive amount of his techniques to save the passengers when the train derailed. He then asked Tanjiro if an Upper Rank had really come and if they were that strong, which the youth confirmed. A tearful Tanjiro expressed his lack of strength and aid to Kyojuro's fight, wondering if he could ever be like him. Inosuke suddenly burst into the conversation, berating his comrade for his timid words, calling them pointless, and stating that they simply had to live up to their superior's expectations. He informed his comrades that all creatures eventually die, and that they shouldn't shed a tear out of regret, regardless of the cause of it. Zenitsu points out that Inosuke is also crying, causing him to be headbutted by the latter, who also starts beating on Tanjiro, telling him they need to start training as a pair of Kakushi run up to the three. Entertainment District Arc. At the Butterfly Mansion, Zenitsu mulls over Tanjiro and Inosuke's sadness due to Kyojuro Rengoku's death, bringing the former some buns to cheer him up. A distraught Kiyo Terauchi accidentally bashes her head into Zenitsu's, crying out that Tanjiro is missing. An apologetic Kiyo further explains to the disoriented Zenitsu that Shinobu had gotten angry at Tanjiro for training while still injured and he had been instructed to rest. Remembering the extent of his friend's injuries, Zenitsu questions his intelligence. Four months after the passing of Kyojuro Rengoku, the three boys have been training relentlessly at the Butterfly Mansion while occasionally leaving on individual missions. As Zenitsu goes on solo missions, he becomes less of a whiner. Since Tengen Uzui is unwilling to give Aoi Kanzaki up for his mission, Tanjiro demands that he gives her up and offers to go in her place. At that moment, Zenitsu and Inosuke arrive to help protect the girls, and they also offer to go on the mission as well. Afterwards, Zenitsu, along with Inosuke and Tanjiro, are startled by Tengen's speed as he runs. Upon arriving at the Entertainment District, despite Tengen's orders to not get off the cart they are riding on, both Zenitsu and Inosuke jump off, much to Tengen and Tanjiro's chagrin. Zenitsu gets distracted by several courtesans on a balcony and tries to follow them before getting dragged away by Tengen. Tengen then brings to a room to scout out women, causing Zenitsu to go on a mad tangent accusing him of dragging the 3 out to find him a bride. The boy was met with a punch by the Sound Hashira, who clarfiied that he wanted them to search out his 3 wives, Hinatsuru, Makio, and Suma, who went missing in their mission. This caused Zenitsu to go on an envious rant, causing Tengen to punch him agains as punishment for his insubordination, this time knocking him out cold. Zenitsu, along with Tanjiro and Inosuke were dressed up like young courtesan girls to be sold off to the houses that Tengen suspected his wives were hiding out in. They were also given fake names, with Zenitsu being called "Zenko". Much to his dismay, Zenitsu was the last to be picked. He was given to the Kyogoku House, which was suspected of harboring Hinatsuru. Zenitsu became more and more agitated with his situation, due to Tengen having to give him up for free, and being called ugly by the other courtesans. While in the Kyogoku House, Zenitsu overheard the sound of a young girl crying and rushed over. He came upon 3 scared young girls and a broken vase, and when he attempted to comfort one of them, he was approached by a cruel Oiran named Warabihime, who began to insult his appearance. Zenitsu instantly recognized that she was not human, but instead an Upper Rank demon due to the fact that he sense her presence despite his super-enhanced hearing. The demon then directed her wrath towards one of the girls by grabbing her by the ear and yelling at her, causing Zenitsu, in a rare bout of courage, to grab the demon's arm and demand that she stopped. The demon, named Daki, recognized Zenitsu as a demon slayer, and tossed him aside, knocking the boy out cold. When he awoke, he was greeted by the 3 girls he saved who thanked him for kindness. However, when they left and Zenitsu was left alone in his bedroom, Daki abducted him by using her sentient obi sashes. Zenitsu was knocked unconscious by his kidnapping but was trapped inside Daki's obis, and he was held prisoner underground alongside other women Daki and her belt had kidnapped and planned to store and eat at a later date, including Makio and Suma. Inosuke was able to find his way to Daki's morbid underground cellar and managed to free Zenitsu. Still unconscious and now at his most powerful, Zenitsu was able to utilize Thunder Breathing in order to slice up overwhelming numbers of obis, in the process freeing the woman Daki had imprisoned. With the aid of Inosuke, Makio, Suma, and Tengen who had arrived to the fight, all obi sashes would be cut. Daki herself was fighting Tanjiro off in the distance, leading Tengen to rush towards his location with Inosuke and the asleep Zenitsu to follow. Swordsmith Village Arc. After the events of the Entertainment District Arc, Zenitsu woke up two days before Tanjiro did and went on a mission against his will. He traveled to a snowy area with a new band of Demon Slayers, although he tried to escape and had to be restrained by them. His uncooperative, cowardly behavior and his begging to reunite with his old comrades drew the ire of his peers. Later on, when Tanjiro tried to catch the the incredibly speedy Upper Rank 4 Hantengu, he thought of Zenitsu giving him a verbal lesson on how to utilize Thunder Breathing, a skill he used twice in order to catch up to the demon. Hashira Training Arc. Unbeknownst to him, his crush Nezuko had gained an immunity to the sunlight during Tanjiro's fight in the Swordsmith Village. He was extremely excited by the news, and began to scream with joy and enamorment when reuniting with her. However, due to Inosuke teaching her how to say his name, plus the fact that she had the mentality of a young child, she mistakenly greeted him as Inosuke, which infuriated him. Legacy. Following the battle against Muzan, Zenitsu would live alongside Tanjiro, Nezuko and Inosuke. At some point he would marry with Nezuko and start a family that would eventually yield great-grandchildren in the present day, Yoshiteru Agatsuma and Toko Agatsuma. He would write the adventures of the Demon Slayer Corps and their final struggle against Muzan in a book.

Zenitsu Agatsuma vs Kaigaku Zenitsu Agatsuma vs Kaigaku is a battle that took place in the Infinity Castle. It focuses on the battle between Demon Slayer Zenitsu Agatsuma against Upper Rank Six Kaigaku. Prologue. Zenitsu, while walking through the castle, encounters his old senior, Kaigaku, whom he hears talking from behind a door. He tells the demon to come on out as he knows it's him. Kaigaku dislikes the lack of respect Zenitsu shows and tells him that it's no way to talk to his senior. Zenitsu responds that, because he is a demon, he no longer considers Kaigaku his senior. Kaigaku sneers at Zenitsu that he's shabby and still just a weakling, then trying to provoke him by asking if Zenitsu had become a Hashira or if he could use anything other than Thunder Breathing's First Form. Zenitsu calmly retorts that Kaigaku seems thrilled to be the lowest-ranked of the Upper Ranks, despite the fact that he's simply filling an empty slot. Intrigued by Zenitsu's insult, Kaigaku laughs and says that he now knows how to talk back. Zenitsu wants to know why Kaigaku became a demon, since he used to be someone who was passionate about learning Thunder Breathing and becoming the previous Thunder Hashira's successor. He proceeds to let out his frustration on Kaigaku by telling him he was the cause of Jigoro's, their master's, death, since Kaigaku becoming a demon was the reason he committed seppuku and died a slow, agonizing death on his own. Kaigaku says he believes that only those who know his value are worth caring about and procedes to mock Jigoro, calling him a senile old man. This is met with great disdain from Zenitsu, who replies it is pitiful for Jigoro to have two inferior swordsmen to have as his replacement. The comment Zenitsu makes towards Kaigaku enrages him, and he tells Zenitsu to not lump him in the same boat as him. He draws his blade and initiates the battle. Battle. Kaigaku attempts to kill Zenitsu using his Blood Demon Art enhanced Thunder Breathing, Fourth Form: Distant Thunder, Zenitsu quick as he is, draws his sword and slashes past Kaigaku's neck, calling him trash and saying he was too slow. Kaigaku realizes that Zenitsu is much more versatile and skilled with his swordsmanship than before. However, he still believes that no matter how much Zenitsu trains, he can never defeat an Upper Rank like him. Zenitsu then is slashed by Kaigaku with the Thunder Breathing, Second Form: Rice Spirit. Zenitsu remarks that Kaigaku has eaten too many people and questions him he can no tell what is right or wrong, to which Kaigaku pridefully responds that he does. As Kaigaku uses the Thunder Breathing, Third Form: Thunder Swarm, he says that those who judge him correctly and accept him for who he is are correct and those who don't accept him are wrong. Kaigaku then uses the Thunder Breathing, Fifth Form: Heat Lightning and taunts at Zenitsu, praising his own Blood Demon enhanced Forms. He explains that once his Thunder Breathing forms slash Zenitsu's body, his skin and flesh burns and cracks apart as he uses the Thunder Breathing, Sixth Form: Rumble and Flash. While falling, Zenitsu reflects on his relationship with Kaigaku before, and reflects how he and Kaigaku could not get along. He jumps onto a wall and uses his own breathing form: Thunder Breathing, Seventh Form: Honoikazuchi no Kami. Kaigaku is beheaded while falling, and curses Zenitsu while falling with him. Aftermath. While falling, Zenitsu is rescued by Yushiro. Yushiro mocks Kaigaku that it is pathetic to die alone. Kaigaku dies miserably and Zenitsu is rescued. As Zenitsu lays there while being treated by Yushiro, he dazes off and wakes up in a dream world where he sees Jigoro, As he apologizes to Jigoro that he was unable to get along with Kaigaku, Jigoro looks up to him and says "Zenitsu, You are my pride and joy."

Zenitsu Agatsuma vs Spider Demon (Son) Zenitsu Agatsuma vs Spider Demon (Son) was a battle that took place on Mount Natagumo. It focuses on the battle between Demon Slayer Zenitsu Agatsuma against Son of the Spider Family. Prologue. After recovering from his battle in the Tsuzumi Mansion and protecting Nezuko Kamado from the stranger Inosuke Hashibira, Zenitsu is directed to a new mission in the forests of Mount Natagumo, along with Tanjiro Kamado and the newly-joined Inosuke. However, as they reach the edge of the woods by nightfall, Zenitsu becomes unnerved and frightened, thanks to his enhanced hearing and heightened perception. He becomes even more reluctant when the three watch a fellow Demon Slayer being abducted by something and pulled into the forest. Deciding to stay behind, he sits on the dirt path as Tanjiro and Inosuke head on into Mount Natagumo. As he sits by himself alone, his sparrow Chuntaro attempts to push him to continue into the woods. Though the bird's attempts fail, Zenitsu's realization that Nezuko is in the forests with Tanjiro eventually causes him to sprint into the woods to search for her. Though fear grips him as he walks into Mount Natagumo, it is replaced by frustration as he soon finds himself lost, feebly calling to Nezuko, Tanjiro, and Inosuke. Unaware he is being followed, Zenitsu ventures deeper into the woods, feeling a prick on his hand and finding the forest emits a strong pungent odour. Eventually, something crawls from behind him; he turns around to yell at it but looks down to see a large spider with a human head. Terrified, he sprints away, heading further into Mount Natagumo. As he yells his wish to be awaken from a perceived nightmare, he soon finds himself in a clearing, with a suspended house in the middle. Strewn through the tree tops are long strands of silk, with captured Demon Slayers hanging from them. Watching as they turn into the spiders he saw earlier, he is interrupted by the appearance of a giant spider from the house. "Son" of the Spider Family emerges, horrifying the Demon Slayer even more. Battle. Zenitsu tries to run away but Son taunts him by stating that he has already been bitten; he looks down and sees a blister and bruising on his hand, a bite from a spider earlier. The demon tell him that the poison will first cause pain, then dizziness, followed by nausea. Eventually, he will lost consciousness and then transform into a spider as well. Taunting him over his fate, Son sends numerous spiders to attack him, to which Zenitsu responds by climbing up a tree. Son jokingly tells him not to worry, as his intelligence will be reduced as he transforms. Upset over his impending doom, the Demon Slayer rants that he has no one that cares for him, to which Son responds to by offering another dose of poison. Zenitsu clings to the tree and reminisces on his past; all the events that led to him eventually meeting his master to become a Demon Slayer. Like now, he had climbed up a tree and refused to continue training due to his weak resolve, despite his desires to live up to his trainer's expectations. Suddenly, a lightning bolt had struck him, causing his hair to turn blonde and him to fall out. Zenitsu recalls that moment and laments that everything he has experienced had led up to his transformation into a spider. As Son watches his strange opponent with curiosity and confusion, clumps of hair rip off of Zenitsu's head, showing that the poison is slowly affecting him. As the spider demons climb up to take him, Zenitsu suddenly loses consciousness and falls off the branch he was on, to the Spider Demon's laughter. Unable to believe he was sent to kill his family, the demon's pride disappears when Zenitsu begins to breathe, uprighting his body and planting his feet to the tree. He launches himself at Son, who retaliates with Poison Sputum, spitting a blob of acidic poison. Shocked by his change in demeanour, Son continues to launch his poison at the Demon Slayer, where he soon realizes from his continual sole stance that Zenitsu is only capable of using one form. As time ticks down and the poison continues to affect his body, Son mocks his opponent as a Demon Slayer for only being able to do one thing. Zenitsu then recalls his master's reaction to him only able to do one form; encouraging him to hone it to perfection. He remembers that despite the humiliation and pain throughout his entire life, his master's encouragement had always given him the drive to keep moving forward. Son then signals for his spiders to envenomate Zenitsu with more poison; using their barbed tongue, they try to stab Zenitsu, who successfully dodges in time but suddenly coughs blood and stops, allowing the demons to overwhelm him. Landing to the ground and watching his minions attack with delight, he suddenly sees the spiders blown away as lightning seemingly envelops Zenitsu, frightening the Spider Demon. Zenitsu uses Thunder Breathing, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash and extends it Sixfold. Son desperate tries to launch a Poison Sputum blob but the poison doesn't reach Zenitsu. As he speeds around the clearing to look for a way to attack, Son cowers in fear and retreats back into his house. Seeing his chance, Zenitsu launches himself at the house, uses a thread to propel himself at the demon and decapitates Son instantly. Aftermath. As his head fall and he begins to fade into ash, Son curses Zenitsu for how he had managed to defeat him despite being severely weakened by the poison's effects and wondered how he had managed to get the best of him, before finally dying. Zenitsu lands atop the suspended house, realizing his dream to get stronger and help people has come true. Chuntaro lands down and tears up at the sight of his owner so badly wounded; Zenitsu attempts to apologize to his companion but the sparrow flies away. Using his breathing, he attempts to slow down the poison's circulation. Eventually, after some time, Zenitsu is found by the Insect Hashira Shinobu Kocho, who had been tasked with aiding the Mount Natagumo mission when the Corps had learned about numerous deaths among the Demon Slayers. Commending him for slowing the poison, she injects him with an antidote that cures him of the poison, though his arms and legs have shrivelled as a result of his ordeal. Soon, he is taken down the house by the Kakushi, patched up, and taken to the Butterfly Mansion to heal.

Zenitsu Agatsuma vs Tongue Demon Zenitsu Agatsuma vs Tongue Demon was a skirmish that takes place in the Tsuzumi Mansion. It focuses on the confrontation between the Demon Slayer Zenitsu Agatsuma and one of the three demons inside the mansion. Prologue. As they walk around the halls of the mansion, a nervous and wary Zenitsu continues to hold onto Shoichi's hand as the duo attempt to find a way out. Calling out to Zenitsu, only to be told off by the latter for making a loud noise, Shoichi then tells Zenitsu how he feels unsafe around him, especially considering how frightened Zenitsu was. Zenitsu begins to profusely apologize and tell him that they should stay quiet to avoid being attacked by demons, just as the Tongue Demon appears in front of them. Zenitsu, now much more terrified than before, desperately tells the demon to stay back, additionally saying that saying neither he nor Shoichi would taste good as they begin to run away. The demon simply responds by saying that he would not know how they would taste if he did not try, proceeding to chase and attack them. After running into a room, Zenitsu collapses onto the ground out of sheer fear, telling Shoichi to escape and leave him. The young boy of the two on the other hand immediately refuses and Zenitsu is further pressured with his responsibility to save Shoichi. As the Tongue Demon approaches them, he tells them that he is going to suck their brains out through their ears. Zenitsu suddenly passes out due to both his fear and the stress of the current situation finally catching up to him. Shoichi begs him to wake up just as the demon lashes out its tongue. Battle. An unexpected gesture occurs as the demon's tongue is cut off by Zenitsu as the latter stands with his head hung low; subconscious sustaining him. Moving into the stance for using Thunder Breathing, First Form: Thunderclap and Flash, Zenitsu gets ready to decapitate the Tongue Demon without hesitation. With one swift move and a direct slice from Zenitsu's Nichirin Sword, the demon's head now lies on the ground, as Zenitsu easily goes through with his attack, now standing victorious against the demon in battle. Aftermath. Shoichi gapes in shock while he looks at Zenitsu who wakes up and screams at the sight of the deceased demon's head, now decapitated from its body. The confused Demon Slayer misunderstands the situation and begins to express extreme gratitude towards Shoichi for "saving" the pair, also telling him he should have let possessed extreme strength much earlier on. Shoichi, now at a loss for words and decides not to say anything, telling Zenitsu they should go.

Nezuko Kamado/Synopsis History. Nezuko grew up on a mountain alongside her older brother, Tanjiro, and the rest of her siblings and mother, as the eldest daughter of the Kamado family. She presumably took care of her younger siblings as an assistant to her mother, as is briefly witnessed prior to her family's death. Unlike Tanjiro, who was responsible for selling firewood in town, Nezuko would usually help out around the family home. The family was somewhat poor and, as a result, Nezuko sometimes had to go without things like new clothes in order to ensure that the rest of her siblings had enough food to eat. She did not appear to view this as a burden, and instead was simply just content with helping her family. Synopsis. Final Selection Arc. After a Demon attack kills almost her entire family, Nezuko is turned into a Demon by the orchestrator of said attack, Muzan Kibutsuji. At first, she is rather wild and even attacks her single remaining brother, however she quickly comes to her senses and swiftly jumps in to defend him from Giyu Tomioka when the Hashira tries to harm him. Following her awakening after their short fight and her brother receiving instructions from Giyu to find a man named "Sakonji Urokodaki," Nezuko is taken by Tanjiro to first bury and pay their respects to their deceased family. She then hides in a nearby cave, since the sun has risen, and waits for her brother to find something to carry her in so they can travel by day. The two begin to travel towards Sakonji's home, but run into a Demon, who has just killed and is preying on a family, on their way. Tanjiro attacks the Demon, hitting it in the jaw with his axe, but it swiftly heals the wound and boasts about its regeneration abilities. Angered, the Demon pounces on Tanjiro, but Nezuko swiftly kicks its head off, also kicking its body away as it continues to attack. The pair manage to fend off the Demon, pinning its head to a tree and throwing its body off a mountain, until Sakonji suddenly appears and informs them that they cannot kill a Demon through these methods. Tanjiro hesitates to deliver the final blow, and, eventually, the sun rises, causing the Demon to disintegrate and Nezuko to flee to the safety of the house. After a short lecture and test of strength, the siblings are taken in by Sakonji, who then begins training Tanjiro in the Water Breathing Breathing Style. Nezuko then sleeps for the full two years Tanjiro spends training, not even awakening after he leaves for the Final Selection. Sakonji keeps her in check the entire time, until Tanjiro successfully passes the Final Selection, because it is only then, when he returns to them, that Nezuko awakens. She greets Tanjiro, embracing him and relieving him of his fears. It is during this time we learn that Sakonji used suggestive hypnosis on Nezuko while she was asleep to reinforce a simple mindset; that all humans were members of her "family" and therefore she should protect them, and also to kill all demons. Kidnapper's Bog Arc. Nezuko accompanies Tanjiro to his first mission, where she emerges from her box to fight a copy of the Swamp Demon. She falls asleep after the Demon is defeated. Tsuzumi Mansion Arc. Nezuko spends most of this arc in her box, as it takes place during the day. Inosuke tried attacking her box because he could smell her demon blood, but Zenitsu protected her box with his body. Mount Natagumo Arc. Nezuko takes part in the battle against Lower Rank 5, Rui. She helps her brother at first using herself as a shield against Rui's threads but then is captured and tied up by him to the top of several trees upside down, falling asleep as a result of blood loss. Her mom's spirit asks her to wake up and help Tanjiro for saving him from Rui. She wakes up for a moment and deal the killing blow with her newly awakened Blood Demon Art, thanks to her blood that stained on Tanjiro's sword previously and through the same threads that Rui used to tie her up for defending against Tanjiro last attack instead. After that fight, Shinobu tried to stab her with poison but her attack is blocked by Giyu. Tanjiro tried to escape with Nezuko from the scene, but he fails after Kanao (without being seen by him) stomps on his back. Tanjiro asks Nezuko to run and his jaw ends broken after a kick on his head. Nezuko proceeds to turn into a small child and make a run for her life. Before Kanao cuts a cornered Nezuko's head off, a crow appears ordering to bring the Kamado siblings to Demon Slayers' headquarters. She decided on getting to headquarters inside her box. Rehabilitation Training Arc. She is awakened by Sanemi, who stabs her in an attempt to provoke her and her brother. Sanemi trying to prove that Nezuko is dangerous, uses his marechi blood as a bait. Nezuko recalls her family and refuses to drink it at the end. She ends up becoming furious at Sanemi after being awaken and stabbed. She is carried out to the Butterfly Mansion alongside her elder brother. Nezuko spends almost the entire arc sleeping to recover her strength after she used her Blood Demon Art for the first time against Rui on Mount Natagumo. Zenitsu tells her about their breathing holding training and then promises her to take her at night where the flower he's holding was blooming. Moreover, he took the goldfish bowl from Shinobu's room without asking and shows it to Nezuko. Later, Aoi found him and chewed him out thoroughly. Since Muzan is usually able to discern demons' location whom him has given blood to and thanks to Nezuko being taken into Ubuyashiki's headquarters, he'd normally knows where to find him out, however it is learned that, like Tamayo, Nezuko has unknowingly broken that bond. Mugen Train Arc. Nezuko gets out of her box, only to get confused by Kyojuro Rengoku, whom is strangling a human while he's asleep. She tries to wake her brother up for a head pat and then proceeds to give him a headbutt in frustration when she is unable to rouse him. However, due to Tanjiro's comically hard forehead, she ends up splitting her own forehead open and starts bleeding. This causes her to cry and use her Blood Demon Art on his brother. She uses it on the ropes of the Demon Slayers after they were put to sleep by Lower Rank 1, Enmu. She fights with her fingernails since she'll fall asleep pretty soon if she uses her blood. She's helped by a sleeping Zenitsu whom declares he will protect her, which she looks on in awe. Her admiration is quickly dispelled however, as he pops back asleep mid sentence and begins to snore. Both of them defend three cars of the train from Enmu. After the train is stopped and during the fight between Kyojuro and Akaza, she falls asleep on the arms of Zenitsu who is asleep as well. Before Kyojuro dies, he finally acknowledges Nezuko as a member of the Demon Slayer Corps since she protected the humans on the train. Zenitsu gets her into the box to protect her from the sunlight. Entertainment District Arc. She awakens to her berserk-like Demon Transformation ability during the fight with Daki, the female half of Upper Rank 6. After almost consuming a human in her animalistic state, she is subdued by Tanjiro and is sidelined for the rest of the fight. She proves instrumental in saving several Demon Slayers from the brink of death by using her Exploding Blood ability to burn the lethal poison of Gyutaro, the male half of Upper Rank 6, out of their blood. Swordsmith Village Arc. Nezuko almost disintegrates in the sunlight, but then suddenly becomes a Demon immune to the sun, something which Muzan had tried so hard to find. She assists Genya as they fight the Upper Rank 4, Hantengu. Hashira Training Arc. During this time, Nezuko took Tamayo's medicine and was under the care of Sakonji Urokodaki, before taking the medicine, Nezuko was delighted to see Urokodaki. Sunrise Countdown Arc. Nezuko, appearing to have sensed something, gets up. As Sakonji asks the girl whats wrong, she dashes into the forest, seemingly aware of and drawn to Tanjiro's impending death. Kiriya, worried and wondering what to do, yells for her to be retrieved. Kiriya then remembers his father's words to let Nezuko do as she pleases, allowing her to leave. Urokodaki still chases her but Nezuko is far too fast for him. She then leaps off of a cliff, landing safely in the forest below. As Nezuko rushes towards the city, she begins to undergo drastic changes. Her right eye becomes that of her human self, and her hair has returned to being solely black. Nezuko remembers Muzan slaughtering her family, and becomes enraged. She then remembers how Tanjiro carried her through the snow, panicked and desperate, trying to save her life. She recalls every ally and friend she has made along the way and every tender moment she shared with them, including Sanemi stabbing her. As her reversion continues, her hands have now become human. She envisions Tanjiro holding his hand out to her and his promise to protect her, as she becomes fully human once more.

Nichika Ubuyashiki is the second eldest daughter of Kagaya Ubuyashiki. Appearance. Like the rest of her family, Nichika had large eyes with pale skin. She wore her short, white hair in a blunt bob with a fringe. Nichika wore a dark blue with purple flowers as its pattern and a maroon with a cream yellow and juban under everything. On the left side of her hair, she donned a yellow ribbon. Personality. Not much was known about her personality, but she does show a sense of loyalty for dying along with her twin sister when their father sacrificed himself to defeat Muzan. Kiriya describes his sister as more skilled than him. History. Nichika was born into the family of Kagaya and Amane Ubuyashiki along with quintupletssiblings Hinaki, Kiriya, Kuina and Kanata and is one of the eldest daughters in the family, she stayed by his side and died with him with her sister Hinaki. Synopsis. Mount Natagumo Arc. Nichika stands next to Kagaya and Hinaki as Kagaya instructs Giyu Tomioka and Shinobu Kocho to head for Mount Natagumo. Rehabilitation Training Arc. Nichika helps Kagaya at the Hashira meeting with her sister. Infinity Castle Arc. Nichika sacrifices herself by the explosion of the Ubuyashiki Mansion along with her sister, father and mother.

Nichirin Sword are special blades used by Demon Slayers made specifically for the purpose of slaying demons. Description. Nichirin Swords (among other Nichirin bladed weapons) are the main weapons used by Demon Slayers in the Demon Slayer Corps in order to kill demons. They are forged with and, both of which are found on high mountains like the Sunlight Mountain, which is perpetually bathed in sunlight all throughout the year on . As they constantly absorb sunlight, decapitating demons with Nichirin Swords can permanently kill them. Once their neck-bone is slashed by the weapon, their heads and bodies disintegrate into ash in a similar fashion to when exposed to sunlight. However, despite their sunlight-absorbent properties, Nichirin Swords are less effective when used to slash other parts of a demon's body, making beheading the only viable option for Demon Slayers. Nichirin Swords take on a distinct color when first drawn by its owner, which is why they are also referred to as "Color Changing ". However, the holder is required to have a certain amount of skill, or the blade will not change color. Demon Slayer recruits choose their own ore after successfully passing Final Selection. The ore will then be used by a swordsmith of the Swordsmith Village during the forging process, and the swordsmith will personally bring the weapon to the Demon Slayer. After the Demon Slayer reaches the rank of Hashira, their weapons will be engraved with the words . This tradition came some time after the creation of the sword that Tanjiro and Kotetsu found inside the Yoriichi Type Zero, which only had the on it and was created for the sole purpose of annihilating demons. List of Known Nichirin Weapons. Handguards. Each Nichirin Sword contains a handguard, or, that protects the swordsman from cutting themselves when they have a loose grip. It is located where the handle and the blade meet and can come in a variety of colors and shapes. Weapon Colors. Nichirin Swords change color depending upon the user, making each blade unique. They can be of many colors. Zenitsu's blade is unique in that its coloration does not form as a solid band but instead as a lightning motif down the length of the blade. The reason for this patterning is unknown; however, when giving Tanjiro his new sword, Hotaru remarked that the past wielder of the blade before its refinery must have been a very strong swordsman. Given this statement, it is implied that a stronger skill level can create patterns or slight changes in a Nichirin Sword's coloration. Each color is said to impart certain properties to the blade. The properties of black Nichirin Swords are not well understood, causing them to be considered a bad omen that the Demon Slayer will not progress far (due to dying before much can be learned about the blade). It can be assumed that the color of the sword is associated with the Breathing Style the user is best suited for: Bright Red Nichirin Swords. By raising the temperature of the blade, a Nichirin Sword will turn shining bright red. Bright red Nichirin swords hamper the regeneration of demons and can generate extreme heat that can induce immense pain to demons. There are only 3 known methods to turn a Nichirin sword bright red: Using Nezuko's Blood Demon Art, raising the temperature of the blade with a strong grip, and clashing two Nichirin Swords together (the latter two only capable of being achieved when the Demon Slayer Mark is present).

Ninju , also referred to as Shino Buff Mice, are intelligent mice that work for Tengen Uzui. Overview. The mice are specially trained to be assistants to Tengen and his acquaintances, as seen during the events at Yoshiwara, Tokyo. They are strong enough to carry one sword per mouse and are capable of navigating small spaces that humans normally wouldn't be able to. Appearance. The mice have pointed snouts and large rounded pink ears. Their fur is mostly grey, but the parts covering their legs and hands are black. Unlike regular mice, the Ninju have extraordinarily large muscles. Like their owner, they wear a headband of pale grey that's decorated by three big light pink gemstones arranged in a line.

Northwest Town is a location in the Kidnapper's Bog Arc. It is the location of Tanjiro Kamado's first mission after he officially became a Demon Slayer after passing the Final Selection. Overview. The town is a neighboring town near Mount Sagiri. It's depicted as a rural village surrounded by dense forests and marshlands. It's a secluded and eerie place with a haunting atmosphere. The landscape is depicted as dark and foreboding, adding to the sense of danger and suspense. History. Every night in the Northwest Town, another young girl mysteriously disappears.

Obanai Iguro is a major supporting character of "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba". He is a Demon Slayer of the Demon Slayer Corps and the current . Appearance. Obanai is a young man of short stature, pale skin complexion, and a fairly muscular build. He has straight-edged black hair of varying lengths, the longest reaching down to his shoulders and the shortest stopping at his cheekbones, which he wears down with two shorter strands hanging between his eyes. His eyes are almond-shaped and tilt upwards on the far sides, and are unique colored due to Obanai possessing heterochromia—his right eye is yellow and his left eye is turquoise. He is partially blind, barely able to see out of his right eye. Obanai's mouth is usually hidden by the bandage he wears over his lower face to hide his large facial scars, which were the result of his family horrifically cutting open his mouth to resemble that of a snake's gape. He wears a navy blue version of the standard Demon Slayer uniform, along with a black and white striped, the hem and cuffs of which are striped length ways rather than vertically, which covers his hands. Obanai also sports bandages in place of the leg-wraps around his calves giving the resemblance of, as well as another set of bandages that cover his mouth, and white with blue-strapped on his feet. He is also always seen with his white snake, Kaburamaru, wrapped around his shoulders. During the battle with Muzan, Obanai and the other remaining Hashira are attacked by the demon's flailing whips, and Obanai is left with three long slanted scratches over his eyes, rendering him completely blind. When he was a child, Obanai had waist-length hair that he wore tied down his back with a long white bandage and a regular-looking mouth before it got cut by his family. He also wore a plain white kimono. Personality. Obanai is a very harsh and strict individual who shows no concern for those who do not abide by the rules of the Demon Slayer Corps. His expectations for his fellow Demon Slayers are quite unrealistic, as he was seen berating Tengen Uzui for suffering heavy wounds against the "weakest" Upper Rank and telling him to "fight to the death" when Tengen insists on retiring. Tengen's retirement also highlights Obanai's devotion to the future of the Demon Slayer Corps, often at others' expense, such as when he ties up lower-ranked Demon Slayers and uses them as obstacles during Hashira Training for relatively petty reasons. He also sees the newer Demon Slayer recruits as weak and incapable of improvement, expressing surprise when Tengen informs him that Tanjiro Kamado survived the battle with Daki and Gyutaro. Obanai has a rather prominent habit of pointing at people with his finger in an accusatory manner while berating them or talking badly about someone. Despite his merciless personality, there are two people he cares deeply about: Kagaya Ubuyashiki and Mitsuri Kanroji. He has a crush on Mitsuri, as he often lets his feelings shine through by sharing meals with her and giving gifts, such as the signature green socks she wears with her uniform. Obanai seems to let his overprotectiveness of Mitsuri show at times, such as when he threatens Tanjiro for growing too close to her. It was implied that he has a crush on Mitsuri because of her cheerful personality that didn't let any of the hellish training she had gone through to radiate in the slightest. Talking with her also made him forget all the strife and conflict he had encountered during his past and made him feel as if he was an ordinary young man. Like all the Hashira, Obanai has a great deal of respect for Kagaya too. Obanai is also noted to possess an immense sense of self-loathing due to the fact that he was born to a selfish and immoral clan who would mercilessly sacrifice even newborn children to a demon for their own monetary gain. Obanai considers himself and his family so tainted that years after they were killed, he still felt as if his family were digging their nails into his skin to make sure he couldn't go anywhere. He even goes as far as to believe that, in order for him to ever be worthy of Mitsuri, he would first have to die and cleanse himself of his corrupted blood before confessing his feelings to her. His upbringing also seems to be the cause of his since he was born into a family of only women who treated him like a tool. The trauma of his past can also be seen in the form of his facial bandages that he dons to cover the terrible scars he received, never removing it until the . In addition to the horrible treatment he received from his family, of being treated as a mere tool and sacrifice, Obanai was deeply affected by the words of resentment and hatred from his only surviving cousin when she said that the entire family died simply because he ran away. Although he recognized that her grudge and words were illogical, he chose to accept that he was at fault and even considered himself as corrupt as his family was, believing he was not worthy to live a normal life. This shows that despite the various unpleasant traits of his personality, Obanai actually has a conscience and morals, unlike his family. Obanai has an incredible sense of determination, continuing the fight against Muzan even after he is completely blinded and covered in wounds. His ability to protect Giyu and Tanjiro throughout the fight, as well as thanking Tanjiro for helping him and later even took a blow for him proves that Obanai was able to drop his initial grudges and become more open with people he was rude to prior. Abilities. Overall Abilities. As a Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps, Obanai is a very powerful and skilled combatant. It was revealed that he was more or less blind in his right eye, meaning he ascended to the highest rank in the Demon Slayer Corps with one functioning eye. This, in addition to his small physique and lesser physical strength when compared to his peers, makes it especially impressive that Obanai managed to attain the title of Hashira. During the events in the Infinity Castle, Obanai was able to quickly decapitate numerous demons on par with Lower Ranks with ease and hold back the newly appointed Upper Rank Four, Nakime. When engaging in battle with the Demon King, Muzan Kibutsuji, Obanai was able to land a great deal of hits on him, slashing off limbs and nearly beheading him over the course of the . After Obanai, Giyu, Sanemi, Gyomei, Zenitsu, Inosuke and Kanao were heavily injured by Muzan's attack, Obanai was the first to regain consciousness and aid Tanjiro despite having his eyes clawed out during the attack earlier. While it should be noted that Muzan was severely weakened by the drugs in his body, he and Tanjiro nonetheless managed to fend off and push the Demon King into a corner by themselves, displaying incredible stamina and endurance. After getting directly hit by Muzan's Shockwave Energy Blast technique, he still took a hit for Tanjiro when Muzan was about to bite his head off. When the Demon King swelled his flesh and exponentially grew in size, Obanai still possessed enough stamina to unleash one technique that aided in slowing Muzan down. Even though Obanai lost his life at the end of the battle, he was undoubtedly one of the biggest contributors in subduing the Demon King till the arrival of dawn. Demon Slayer Abilities. Demon Slayer Mark: During, Obanai awakened his own Demon Slayer Mark, which took the form of three snake like tattoo patterns with large dots, stretching from his left arm to the left side of his chest. The Mark greatly enhanced all of Obanai's physical abilities, as seen where he was able to land powerful sword slashes against Muzan, swiftly dodge and maneuver himself to avoid all of his immensely fast attacks, and increase his physical stamina and durability, allowing him to fight despite being severely injured. Physical Abilities. Enhanced Strength: Despite his short stature and lesser physical strength due to his upbringing, especially when compared to the other Hashira, Obanai still possesses a great amount of physical strength, as shown when he pins Tanjiro to the ground with so much force that he couldn't move or breathe. He was also able to slash the body of Muzan Kibutsuji on a multitude of occasions. Obanai was also one of the only Demon Slayers able to turn his Nichirin Sword bright red through sheer grip strength, the other being Muichiro Tokito. Immense Speed & Reflexes: As a Hashira, Obanai possesses superhuman levels of speed and reflexes. When Tanjiro was about to get hit by what would likely have been a fatal strike from Muzan, Obanai managed to jump in and save him in time. He was capable of keeping up with Muzan Kibutsuji's whip attacks for an extended period of time without the boost granted by the Demon Slayer Mark and still managed to land many hits on the Demon King. After awakening the mark, Obanai was fast enough to slice off both of Muzan's limbs. Even when completely blinded, Obanai was able to evade many of Muzan's attacks, push him into a corner, and caught up to him and pierced his body when he was fleeing, albeit Muzan was severely weakened then. Obanai was ranked 7th in a race against his fellow Hashira. Immense Stamina & Endurance: Obanai has displayed his phenomenal stamina and endurance on multiple occasions during the events within the Infinity Castle and . Obanai, along with Mitsuri, were able to play an exhausting game of cat and mouse with Upper Rank Four, Nakime for an extended period of time and still had enough energy to arrive to Tanjiro's and Giyu's aid. At the surface, Obanai and his allies were able to stall Muzan for around half an hour, sustaining injuries from poison and his flesh whips, before the Demon King overpowered them. When Muzan incapacitated him, Giyu, Sanemi, Gyomei, Zenitsu, Inosuke and Kanao, Obanai was the first to recover, before all his other fellow Hashira did, despite receiving a nasty injury which clawed out his eyes. Afterwards, Obanai, with Tanjiro's aid, managed to drive Muzan into a corner and fend him of by themselves for another 35 minutes before being hit by Muzan's Shockwave Energy Blast technique which greatly damaged his nervous system. Despite this, Obanai remained steadfast and took a blow for Tanjiro when Muzan was poised to bite his head off. Nearing the end of the battle, Obanai still had enough energy to muster a technique; as such, out of all the Demon Slayers that fought in, Obanai lasted arguably the longest. Fighting Style. Master Swordsman: As a Hashira of the Demon Slayer Corps, Obanai was one of the most powerful and skilled swordsmen in the entire organization. This was shown during Hashira Training where he was entrusted to teach all the other Demon Slayers about sword wielding techniques. Obanai makes use of a unique swordsmanship style that utilizes slithering motions to twist and bend his sword and attacks in impossible ways, allowing him to weave through narrow openings with ease despite wielding a standard wooden sword. His swordsmanship prowess allowed him to slaughter hordes of demons with ease and to keep up with the Demon King himself, Muzan Kibutsuji. Equipment. Twisted Nichirin Katana: Obanai carries around a heavily modified Nichirin katana similar in appearance to an Indonesian Sword, with the blade's shape modeled into waves resembling a slithering snake. It is lavender in color. His katana's tsuba has a gold circular shape engraved with two snakes connected by several plant-like patterns. His handle is light blue and decorated with a twisting wrap of magenta cord. As a Hashira, the words are engraved on the side of the blade. Obanai also carries along a special scabbard made of leather held together by a weak magnetic pull that opens up whenever he uses his katana. It is designed so that Obanai unsheathes his sword vertically instead of horizontally.
